Title: 1. E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

Title: 2. Tootsie
description: An unsuccessful actor disguises himself as a woman in order to get a role on a trashy hospital soap.

Title: 3. An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A young man must complete his work at a Navy Officer Candidate School to become an aviator, with the help of a tough Gunnery Sergeant and his new girlfriend.

Title: 4. Rocky III
description: Rocky faces the ultimate challenge from a powerful new contender, and must turn to a former rival to help regain his throne as the undisputed fighting champion.

Title: 5. Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
description: With the assistance of the Enterprise crew, Admiral Kirk must stop an old nemesis, Khan Noonien Singh, from using the life-generating Genesis Device as the ultimate weapon.

Title: 6. 48 Hrs.
description: A hard-nosed cop reluctantly teams up with a wise-cracking criminal temporarily paroled to him in order to track down a killer.

Title: 7. Poltergeist
description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

Title: 8. The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
description: A town's Sheriff and regular patron of a historical whorehouse fights to keep it running when a television reporter targets it as the Devil's playhouse.

Title: 9. Annie
description: A spunky young orphan is taken in by a rich eccentric, much to the chagrin of the cantankerous woman who runs the orphanage.

Title: 10. The Verdict
description: An alcoholic Boston lawyer fights a law firm dean.

Title: 11. Gandhi
description: The life of the lawyer who became the famed leader of the Indian revolts against the British rule through his philosophy of nonviolent protest.

Title: 12. First Blood
description: A drifting veteran must weaponize the wilderness to survive a relentless manhunt led by a small-town sheriff who pushed his fragile psyche past the point of no return.

Title: 13. The Toy
description: An underemployed reporter finds himself literally purchased as a toy for a rich spoiled brat.

Title: 14. Firefox
description: A retired air force pilot is sent into the Soviet Union on a mission to steal a prototype jet fighter that can be partially controlled by neuralink.

Title: 15. The Dark Crystal
description: On another planet in the distant past, the last of the Gelfling race embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and to restore order to his world.

Title: 16. Conan the Barbarian
description: A powerful warrior seeks to avenge the genocide of his people and the murder of his parents at the hands of a snake cult.

Title: 17. The Sword and the Sorcerer
description: A mercenary with a three-bladed sword rediscovers his royal heritage's dangerous future when he is recruited to help a princess foil the designs of a brutal tyrant and a powerful sorcerer in conquering a land.

Title: 18. Best Friends
description: After five successful years of living and working together, a couple decide to get married. But what they don't count on is how to survive the honeymoon.

Title: 19. Friday the 13th: Part 3
description: Jason Voorhees stalks a group of friends who have just arrived to spend the weekend at a cabin near Crystal Lake.

Title: 20. Richard Pryor: Live on the Sunset Strip
description: Richard Pryor performs his stand-up comedy act on the Sunset Strip.

Title: 21. Tron
description: A computer hacker is abducted into a digital world and forced to participate in gladiatorial games where his only chance of escape is with the help of a heroic security program.

Title: 22. Blade Runner
description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

Title: 23. Young Doctors in Love
description: In a zany parody of hospital soap operas, a new batch of doctors begins their internship at City Hospital.

Title: 24. Sophie's Choice
description: Sophie is the survivor of Nazi concentration camps, who has found a reason to live with Nathan, a sparkling if unsteady American Jew obsessed with the Holocaust.

Title: 25. The World According to Garp
description: A struggling young writer finds his life and work dominated by his unfaithful wife and his radical feminist mother, whose best-selling manifesto turns her into a cultural icon.

Title: 26. Victor/Victoria
description: A struggling female soprano in 1934 Paris finally finds work after posing as a female impersonator, but it complicates her personal life when a visiting Chicago gangster finds himself inexplicably attracted to the seemingly male performer.

Title: 27. Airplane II: The Sequel
description: A computer glitch causes a passenger space shuttle to the moon to head straight for the sun. Can Ted Striker save the day and get the aircraft back on track - again?

Title: 28. Fast Times at Ridgemont High
description: A group of Southern California high school students ignore their studies in favor of indulging in their teenage distractions.

Title: 29. Some Kind of Hero
description: A Vietnam veteran returns home as a hero, but is quickly forgotten and discovers the harsh realities of survival in his own country.

Title: 30. Pink Floyd: The Wall
description: A confined but troubled rock star descends into madness in the midst of his physical and social isolation from everyone.

Title: 31. Things Are Tough All Over
description: Cheech and Chong are hired to drive a limo from Chicago to Las Vegas by two shady Arabs--Mr. Slyman (Cheech) and Prince Habib (Chong). Unbeknownst to them, five million dollars of dirty money has been stuffed throughout the car.

Title: 32. Night Shift
description: A mild-mannered morgue attendant is assigned to the night shift, and his new coworker, along with his prostitute neighbor, convince him of running a prostitution ring out of the morgue.

Title: 33. Creepshow
description: Five grisly tales from a kid's comic book about a murdered father rising from his grave, a bizarre meteor, a vengeful husband, a mysterious crate's occupant, and a plague of cockroaches.

Title: 34. The Man from Snowy River
description: In 1880s Australia, after young Jim Craig's father dies, he takes a job at the Harrison cattle ranch, where he is forced to become a man.

Title: 35. Six Pack
description: A race car driver is driving to a race in a motor home with his race car on a trailer. His car gets stripped of parts. He ends up with 6 orphan kids on his way to the race.

Title: 36. My Favorite Year
description: An aging, dissolute matinee idol is slated to appear on a live TV variety show in 1954, and a young comedy writer is tasked with the thankless job of keeping him ready and sober for the broadcast.

Title: 37. The Thing
description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

Title: 38. Deathtrap
description: A struggling playwright invites a young writer to his home to discuss a script, but the meeting spirals into a deadly game of deception and betrayal.

Title: 39. Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
description: Film noir parody with a detective uncovering a sinister plot. Characters from classic noir films appear as scenes from various movies interjected into the story.

Title: 40. Zapped!
description: A high-school whiz kid gains psychic powers from a lab explosion and makes a hit at the prom.

Title: 41. They Call Me Bruce
description: A goofy Korean finds his life hopelessly complicated with people continually confusing him with Bruce Lee.

Title: 42. Death Wish II
description: A traumatized architect relocates to Los Angeles to rebuild his shattered family life. When a vicious street gang destroys his remaining kin, he rejects the failing legal system to wage a methodical, private war against the city's rot.

Title: 43. Kiss Me Goodbye
description: The ghost of a dead husband haunts his wife as she moves back to their house in NYC. She's about to marry an Egyptologist there.

Title: 44. Grease 2
description: A British student at a 1960s American high school must prove himself to the leader of a girls' gang whose members can only date greasers.

Title: 45. The Secret of NIMH
description: To save her ill son, a field mouse must seek the aid of a colony of rats, with whom she has a deeper link than she suspected.

Title: 46. Halloween III: Season of the Witch
description: Kids all over America want Silver Shamrock masks for Halloween. Doctor Daniel Challis seeks to uncover a plot by Silver Shamrock owner Conal Cochran.

Title: 47. Diner
description: A group of college-age buddies struggle with their imminent passage into adulthood in 1959 Baltimore.

Title: 48. The Beastmaster
description: A sword-and-sorcery fantasy about a young man's search for revenge. Armed with supernatural powers, the handsome hero and his animal allies wage war against marauding forces.

Title: 49. Missing
description: When an idealistic American writer disappears during the Chilean coup d'état in September 1973, his wife and father try to find him.

Title: 50. The Entity
description: A woman is tormented by an invisible being.

Title: 51. Visiting Hours
description: A deranged, misogynistic killer assaults a journalist. When he discovers that she survived the attack, he follows her to the hospital to finish her off.

Title: 52. Vice Squad
description: A single mother prostitute, who goes by the name Princess, finds herself forced to work undercover for the police in order to apprehend a homicidal, misogynistic pimp named Ramrod, who will do anything not to get arrested.

Title: 53. Author! Author!
description: While facing the stress of his original play being produced on Broadway, playwright Ivan Travalian deals with having to raise his son, his stepdaughters, and his stepsons.

Title: 54. Amityville II: The Possession
description: A dysfunctional family moves into a new house, which proves to be satanic, resulting in the demonic possession of their teenage son.

Title: 55. Monsignor
description: An ambitious priest seduces a nun and leads the Vatican into shady business during and after World War II.

Title: 56. Making Love
description: A successful young Los Angeles doctor and his equally successful television producer wife find their happily-ever-after life torn asunder when the husband suddenly confronts his long-repressed attraction for other men. Zach and Claire live a comfortable life, secure in their love for one another when Bart, a swinging Los Angeles novelist, walks into Zach's office for a medical check-up and awakens unfamiliar feelings in him. In a move which leaves him feeling wracked with guilt, Zach cancels dinner with Claire in order to go out on a dinner date with Bart. He is inexplicably drawn to this man, who seems intent on keeping him at arm's length. Why can Bart not allow their relationship to grow? he wonders. Exasperated, he asks Bart, "Do you snore? Does anybody ever get a chance to find out?" As Zach's absences become more and more frequent, Claire's concern manifests itself in the suspicion that he is having an affair with another woman. Finally jilted by Bart and feeling alone for the first time in his married life, Zach resolves to tell Claire the truth about himself. Predictably, Claire is shocked that she could have known so little about the man that she has loved for so many years and accuses him of deceiving her from the very start.

Title: 57. The Seduction
description: A popular anchorwoman, Jaime Douglas, is stalked by a photographer who's obsessed with her and wants to win her affections at any cost.

Title: 58. The House on Sorority Row
description: After a seemingly innocent prank goes horribly wrong, a group of sorority sisters celebrating their graduation are stalked and murdered.

Title: 59. Silent Rage
description: A sheriff tries to stop the killing spree of a silent maniacal murderer who, as the result of secret genetic experimentation by an unethical scientist, has the ability to self-heal.

Title: 60. Savannah Smiles
description: Savannah is the only child of a wealthy politician, Richard Driscoll, who is more concerned with his image and career than with his family.

Title: 61. The Year of Living Dangerously
description: A young Australian reporter tries to navigate the political turmoil of Indonesia during the rule of President Sukarno with the help of a diminutive photographer.

Title: 62. Class Reunion
description: It's been 10 years since Lizzie Borden High School's class of '72 graduated, and the preppies, the hippies and the in-crowd have returned to reminisce over good times past. Classmate Walter Baylor has returned too, but with a vengeance.

Title: 63. Hanky Panky
description: An architect is drawn into a web of government secrets when a girl carrying a mysterious package gets into a taxi with him.

Title: 64. Shoot the Moon
description: A mother of four is abandoned by her husband for a younger woman. Husband, wife and children struggle to survive the seemingly inevitable divorce.

Title: 65. A Midsummer Night's Sex Comedy
description: A wacky inventor and his wife invite two other couples to their romantic summer house in the countryside for a weekend party.

Title: 66. Trail of the Pink Panther
description: Journalist Marie Jouvet attempts to uncover the mysterious disappearance of Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau.

Title: 67. If You Could See What I Hear
description: A light comedy/love story based on the life of blind musician Tom Sullivan.

Title: 68. Night Crossing
description: True tale about two men planning to escape from communist East Germany in a hot air balloon, but only if they can take their families with them.

Title: 69. The Pirate Movie
description: A 1980s take-off of The Pirates of Penzance which centers on a noble pirate who leaves his profession and falls in love with a fiery young maiden.

Title: 70. The Beast Within
description: A young woman is sexually assaulted by a mysterious figure in the woods near a small town while traveling at night with her husband. 17 years later, their son slowly begins a horrific bodily transformation into something monstrous.

Title: 71. Tex
description: After their mother dies and their father leaves them, teenage brothers Tex and Mason McCormick struggle to make it on their own.

Title: 72. The Missionary
description: In the early 20th century, devout Reverend Charles Fortescue returns to England from his missionary work in Africa and, despite plans to marry his childhood sweetheart, receives a most unusual assignment: minister to the local prostitutes.

Title: 73. Cat People
description: A woman who was orphaned from a young age finally reunites with her older brother. Matters start to go awry when she slowly discovers the true nature of her family.

Title: 74. I Ought to Be in Pictures
description: Brooklynite Libby Tucker leaves her mother in Brooklyn to visit her screenwriter dad Herbert Tucker in L. A. She hasn't seen him for years and aspires to find a fast-paced life in movies. Along the way, Libby discovers who her dad is.

Title: 75. Fanny and Alexander
description: Two young Swedish children in the 1900s experience the many comedies and tragedies of their lively and affectionate theatrical family, the Ekdahls.

Title: 76. Six Weeks
description: In this heart-warming drama, a terminally ill young girl strives to bring together her wealthy mother and a California politician, fulfilling her dream of having a family during the last six weeks of her life.

Title: 77. Forced Vengeance
description: A casino security guard is forced into violence from when the Hong Kong mob threatens his friends.

Title: 78. The Last Unicorn
description: A beautiful unicorn sets out to learn if she truly is the last of her kind in this sparkling animated musical.

Title: 79. The Soldier
description: Terrorists take over a plutonium bomb and threaten to detonate it in a Saudi Arabian oil field. A special anti-terrorist unit is sent in to stop them.

Title: 80. The Border
description: A corrupt border Agent decides to clean up his act when an impoverished woman's baby is put up for sale on the black market.

Title: 81. Evil Under the Sun
description: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot, solves the murder of an actress at a Balkan resort.

Title: 82. Partners
description: A heterosexual police detective is unnerved when ordered to go undercover with a homosexual police clerk, as a couple, to solve a series of murders in the gay community.

Title: 83. Still of the Night
description: A Manhattan psychiatrist probes a patient's murder and falls for the victim's mysterious mistress.

Title: 84. The Last American Virgin
description: Pizza delivery boy Gary, loudmouth David and hunky Rick are three high school students out to lose their virginity any way they can. Gary falls for transfer student Karen, who gets involved with Rick.

Title: 85. Megaforce
description: Story about a rapid deployment defense unit that is called into action whenever freedom is threatened.

Title: 86. Personal Best
description: The intertwined lives and loves of three highly ranked athletes striving for the national team; Chris bounces between the beds of male coach Terry and her female friend, competitor, and role model Tory.

Title: 87. Paradise
description: In the Middle East in 1823, two teenagers seek refuge at an oasis, where they discover love and intimacy while staying one step ahead of the slaver who massacred their families.

Title: 88. The Grey Fox
description: When an aging, but gentlemanly stagecoach robber is released from prison, he decides to go to Canada to become a train robber.

Title: 89. Cannery Row
description: Monterey, California in the 1940's. Cannery Row - the section of town where the now closed fish canneries are located - is inhabited primarily by the down and out, although many would not move away even if they could. Probably the most upstanding citizen in the area is Doc, a marine biologist who earns a living primarily by collecting and selling marine specimens for research. He is a lost soul who is looking for his place in life. He is running away from his past, one where he is trying to make amends for what he considers a past wrong. But his current life isn't totally satisfying either. He believes that his recent collection of eight baby octopi will help him define that future in conducting research on their behavior. However, he is finding that research is not as easy as he had hoped, and that he is still feeling restless. Into the area comes drifter Suzy DeSoto. She too is a lost soul. With few job skills, she gets a job as what she calls a floozy in the local whorehouse, despite her openly headstrong demeanor not making her well suited to the work. Doc and Suzy are immediately attracted to each other, but theirs is a clash of personalities, despite each truly liking the other. The other residents of Cannery Row do their part for a Doc/Suzy coupling, not always with successful results. Doc and Suzy will first have to find their own lot in life before they can commit to someone else, be it the other or anyone else.

Title: 90. Heidi's Song
description: Orphan Heidi lives with her grandpa in the Swiss Alps. She brings joy to all there. However, her aunt takes her to the city to live as a servant girl to a cold rich strict family and their nice but sad handicapped daughter.

Title: 91. Vigilante
description: After his wife and son got brutalized by a street gang, and a corrupt criminal justice system puts the perpetrators back on the street, a NYC factory worker teams up with a vigilante group to find some measure of bloody justice.

Title: 92. Tempest
description: Unhappy middle-aged architect Philip Dimitrius leaves his wife Antonia and career for a spiritual awakening on a Greek island with his new girlfriend Aretha and teenage daughter, leading to extraordinary results for everyone around him.

Title: 93. Summer Lovers
description: A young American couple and a French woman engage in a threesome in the Greek Islands.

Title: 94. Honkytonk Man
description: A boy with a music talent goes on a journey with his uncle for a stage concert.

Title: 95. Mortuary
description: A young woman investigates the seemingly accidental death of her father, revealing many unsettling secrets and putting her in mortal danger.

Title: 96. Let's Spend the Night Together
description: The Rolling Stones' shows in Tempe, Arizona and East Rutherford, New Jersey during their 1981 US tour.

Title: 97. Jekyll and Hyde... Together Again
description: Dr. Jekyll's research on a drug to avoid surgery yields a powder that transforms his timid self into a sexually uninhibited party animal, complicating his relationships with his fiancée and stripper girlfriend.

Title: 98. La Traviata
description: Violetta meets Alfredo and quickly falls for him. After the lovers run away together, they live in bliss for a short time. However, Alfredo's father, Giorgio, starts to interfere, concerned that Violetta's bad reputation will affect the marriage prospects of Alfredo's sister. Violetta reluctantly leaves Alfredo, but his love is so strong that it leads him to actions that have tragic consequences.

Title: 99. The Return of Martin Guerre
description: In medieval France, some villagers challenge a man's claim of identity when he (as he says) returns home from some time in the army.

Title: 100. Wrong Is Right
description: A TV reporter finds himself in the middle of an Arab leader buying two portable nukes, terrorists, arms dealer, a reporter/CIA spy killed, a US president ordering a K-I-L-L etc.

Title: 101. Fighting Back
description: An Italian deli owner forms a civilian patrol to stop neighborhood crime after his family was attacked on two different occasions. While politicians watch with interest his rising popularity, a vicious pimp will do anything to stop him.

Title: 102. Penitentiary II
description: An ex-con, on parole and trying to straighten his life out, decides to resume his boxing career when one of his prison enemies escapes and kills his girlfriend.

Title: 103. The Challenge
description: A down-and-out American boxer becomes involved in a feud between two Japanese brothers.

Title: 104. Homework
description: Good-looking but virginal "rockstar" teen Tommy tries to score with some of the local high school girls. But a classmate's mom decides to make a man out of him.

Title: 105. Jinxed!
description: A sadistic gambler and his long-suffering Las Vegas lounge singer girlfriend follow a cursed blackjack dealer from casino to casino.

Title: 106. The Final Option
description: It's suspected that a peace/anti-nuke organization in UK has some extremists willing to use terrorism. The action will probably be against an embassy in London. The SAS/Special Air Service try to get the organization infiltrated.

Title: 107. It Came from Hollywood
description: Popular comedians watch and give comments about the worst and silliest films from Hollywood.

Title: 108. The King of Comedy
description: Rupert is an aspiring stand-up comedian, who is willing to go the extra mile in his attempt to appear in the late night show hosted by his idol.

Title: 109. A Stranger Is Watching
description: The 11-year old daughter and girlfriend of a man whose wife had been raped and killed in front of his daughter three years earlier are kidnapped by the same killer. Held captive in a bunker below Grand Central Station, the two plot their escape while the police try to track the kidnapper.

Title: 110. A Little Sex
description: The story of Michael Donovan's amusing - and doomed - attempts to wield life's ultimate double-edged sword: infidelity.

Title: 111. Yes, Giorgio
description: Famous opera singer Giorgio Fini loses his voice during an American tour. He goes to female throat specialist Pamela Taylor and falls in love with her.

Title: 112. The Night of the Shooting Stars
description: In 1944, the residents of a small Italian town under Axis control flee their homes to seek out the liberating Allied forces.

Title: 113. The Draughtsman's Contract
description: A young artist is commissioned by the wife of a wealthy landowner to make a series of drawings of the estate while her husband is away.

Title: 114. Pieces
description: The young and beautiful female students of a college campus in Boston, Massachusetts are being murdered by a mysterious, savage killer who is severing their body parts and using them to create a human jigsaw puzzle of the "perfect woman."

Title: 115. Barbarosa
description: An inexperienced farm boy hooks up with a legendary outlaw in Mexico and both are soon on the run from the law, Mexican bandits, and two families bent on revenge.

Title: 116. Koyaanisqatsi
description: A collection of expertly photographed phenomena with no conventional plot. The footage focuses on the relationship between nature, humanity, and technology.

Title: 117. I, the Jury
description: A PI investigates the murder of his one-armed friend, a PI working on a case. Clues lead to a sex clinic. Bodies pile up.

Title: 118. Endangered Species
description: A former New York City cop relocates to rural Colorado, where he teams with a sheriff investigating a series of bizarre cattle mutilations occurring in the region.

Title: 119. Turkey Shoot
description: In a dystopian future where deviants are held in "re-education" camps, a freedom fighter and an innocent prisoner try to survive their decadent oppressors' game of kill-or-be-killed.

Title: 120. Losin' It
description: Set in 1965, four rowdy teenage guys travel to Tijuana, Mexico for a night of partying when they are joined by a heartbroken housewife who is in town seeking a quick divorce.

Title: 121. Say Amen, Somebody
description: Documentary about the history of the American gospel music scene, focusing on two of the movement's pioneering forces, Thomas A. Dorsey and Willie May Ford Smith.

Title: 122. The Sender
description: A disturbed telepathic man is unable to fully control his ability to transmit his dreams and visions into the minds of the people around him, or even influence reality. A female therapist tries to help him, but his mother gets in the way.

Title: 123. Lookin' to Get Out
description: Alex has had a good day at the track, a bad night at the poker game and hell have a worse time if the guys he owes catch up with him. So Alex and go-along pal Jerry split for Las Vegas...

Title: 124. Enigma
description: A CIA agent tries to infiltrate Soviet intelligence to stop a murderous diabolical plot.

Title: 125. Rendezvous in Paris
description: Berlin 1920: Die seit sieben Jahren verheiratete Anwaltsgattin Evelyne Droste (Claude Jade) verliebt sich in den Amerikaner Frank Davis (Barry Stokes) und folgt ihm heimlich für ein Wochenende nach Paris. Damit setzt Evelyne ihre bürgerliche Existenz aufs Spiel. Nach dem Roman von Vicki Baum.

Title: 126. Come Back to the 5 & Dime Jimmy Dean, Jimmy Dean
description: A fan club of die-hard James Dean fans meet on the 20th anniversary of his death and reconnect, opening old wounds and facing new ones.

Title: 127. L'Étoile du Nord
description: In 1934, a mysterious Frenchman returns to Europe from Egypt.

Title: 128. Lonely Hearts
description: In this offbeat comedy, an unlikely romance develops between a flamboyant, middle-aged piano tuner and an extremely timid office worker.

Title: 129. The House Where Evil Dwells
description: A young American family moves to a House in Kyoto, Japan. It turns out to be haunted by the ghosts of a woman and her lover, who were killed by the woman's husband, as well as the ghost of the husband, who killed himself afterward.

Title: 130. Britannia Hospital
description: The chaotic workings of a hospital with staff on strike.

Title: 131. Monty Python Live at the Hollywood Bowl
description: The Monty Python troupe perform a combination of classic sketches and new material at the Hollywood Bowl.

Title: 132. I'm Dancing as Fast as I Can
description: A true story about Emmy-winning documentary filmmaker Barbara Gordon's Valium addiction and her desperate attempts to kick the habit.

Title: 133. Split Image
description: A rising star young gymnast is lured into a religious cult by a beautiful girl. Every moment with the group brings him more and more under the control of the cult's leader.

Title: 134. Five Days One Summer
description: An aging doctor takes his beautiful young mistress on an alpine walking holiday only to find that she is falling for the charms of a dashing tour guide, but there is a dark secret that looms over the couple.

Title: 135. The Escape Artist
description: Teenager Danny Masters, the son of the late Harry Masters, considered the second best escape artist in history, wants to follow in his father's footsteps, he already a skilled but untested magician. As far as Danny knows, his father died in a dangerous escape routine. Escaping from under his grandmother's roof, Danny, in a step to achieve his goal as they have all his father's old professional paraphernalia, reunites with his Aunt Sibyl and Uncle Burke in the town of Harding where they have a mind-reading act, she who actually can read minds but which only impinges on the smoke and mirrors they've developed with the act itself. In his wanderings around Harding, Danny gets involved with corrupt Stu Quiñones, and indirectly with Stu's equally corrupt father, the town's mayor, Leon Quiñones. This father/son pair no longer associate with each other as although Stu aspires to be as corrupt as his father, Stu's activities are a little too brazen and public for a politician with which to deal. In those dealings, Danny devises what is largely seen as a publicity stunt in reality to get the one up on the Quiñoneses, but in which he will have to show his true mettle as a great escape artist. In the process, Danny may also provide some justice for his father, the true nature of his death which Danny learns along the way.

Title: 136. Bugs Bunny's 3rd Movie: 1001 Rabbit Tales
description: Rival book salesmen Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck are forced by Sultan Yosemite Sam to read fairy tales to his spoiled, selfish son, Prince Abba-Dabba.

Title: 137. Movie Madness
description: An anthology parody of film genres composed of three shorts, spoofing personal growth films, glossy soap operas, and police stories.

Title: 138. White Dog
description: A trainer attempts to retrain a vicious dog that's been raised to attack black people.

Title: 139. The Time Masters
description: Piel, a 7- or 8-year-old boy, is alone on the desert planet Perdide, the only survivor of an attack by giant hornets. Calling for help, Piel's father's friend Jaffar keeps contact with the kid and hurries across space toward Perdide.

Title: 140. Hammett
description: Fictional account of real-life mystery writer Dashiell Hammett, and his involvement in the investigation of a beautiful Chinese cabaret actress' mysterious disappearance in San Francisco.

Title: 141. Cane River
description: The romance between two African Americans who come from a different class background.

Title: 142. Ladies and Gentlemen, the Fabulous Stains
description: The media and disaffected teens mistake the acerbic rants of an obnoxious teenage punk rocker as a rallying cry for the women of America, launching her and her talentless group to national stardom.

Title: 143. Kamikaze 89
description: In a totalitarian society of the future, in which the government controls all facets of the press, a homicide detective investigates a string of bombings, and finds out more than he bargained for.

Title: 144. The Atomic Cafe
description: Disturbing collection of 1940s and 1950s United States government-issued propaganda films designed to reassure Americans that the atomic bomb was not a threat to their safety.

Title: 145. Veronika Voss
description: Partially based on the life of Sybille Schmitz, who found fame under the Nazi regime, but whose career was destroyed afterward. Veronika Voss is a once prominent UFA actress, kept by her doctor, who raises suspicion in a sports journalist.

Title: 146. Losing Ground
description: Sara, a cold college professor, and her husband, an ecstatic painter, spend a summer away from the city, straining their rocky relationship.

Title: 147. Fitzcarraldo
description: The story of Brian Sweeney Fitzgerald, an extremely determined man who intends to build an opera house in the middle of a jungle.

Title: 148. Frances
description: The story of Frances Farmer's meteoric rise to fame in Hollywood and the tragic turn her life took when she was blacklisted.

Title: 149. Tenebrae
description: An American novelist visiting Rome to promote his latest book is stalked and harassed by an obsessed fan who is committing a string of murders that appear to be tributes to his work.

Title: 150. Alone in the Dark
description: A few dangerous and delusional mental patients break out of a mental asylum during a power blackout, and lay siege to their new doctor's house, who, they believe, killed their previous doctor.

Title: 151. The Slumber Party Massacre
description: A female high school student's slumber party turns into a bloodbath, as a newly escaped psychotic serial killer wielding a power drill prowls her neighborhood.

Title: 152. Liquid Sky
description: A small, heroin-seeking UFO lands on a Manhattan roof, observes a bizarre, drug-addicted fashion model, and sucks endorphin from her sexual encounters' brains.

Title: 153. Q: The Winged Serpent
description: NYPD detectives Shepard and Powell are working on a bizarre case of a ritualistic Aztec murder. Meanwhile, something big is attacking people of New York and only greedy small time crook Jimmy Quinn knows where its lair is.

Title: 154. The Plague Dogs
description: Two dogs escape from a laboratory and are hunted as possible carriers of the bubonic plague.

Title: 155. The New York Ripper

The two unlikely duo are supervised by Supt. Nancy Ho, a masculine, fiery-tempered policewoman.

description: Junkman and movie-maker Harlan Hollis struggles to stay alive when a jealous partner in his company hires goons to kill him. Full of amazing car chases, fantastic crashes, and edge-of-your-seat action.

Title: 308. That Championship Season
description: It started as a friendly meeting between 4 old buddies with their former basketball coach and ended up revealing the truth about their relationship. The meeting forces the five men to reveal their true characters, to be honest with each other for the first time in their lives. When the night comes to an end, they decide to go back to the old glorious days and reunite into the team which won that championship season, back in 1957.

Title: 309. El barrendero
description: A humble street sweeper is the sole witness of a crime committed by art thieves.

Title: 310. Sexo às Avessas
description: Heleno and Cláudia reverse the roles traditionally reserved for men and women in marriage. He dedicates himself to domestic chores, feels like a sexual object, and in the club defends the rights of men. On the other hand, she is a unscrupulous executive who cannot see a boy without thinking of a new adventure. Their lives are shaken by the adultery of Claudia with Heleno's friend Almir, who prostitutes himself to raise his son after his wife leaves.

Title: 311. A Tight Spot
description: In this light, fluffy comedy, a low-level clerk cannot make ends meet because his brood is in no way economically cooperative: his daughter is a lawyer looking for work, unsuccessfully; his son is a would-be astronomer who wants to spend his life studying without working; and his other son wants his own wheels. It is enough to send a father to the lottery, or to the soccer pool.

Title: 312. The Outcasts
description: In 1810 Ireland, a man whose wife has died finds that his daughter is accused of being a witch. A magic fiddler comes to her aid.

Title: 313. Slapstick of Another Kind
description: Rich Caleb and Lu Swain give birth to alien twins Wilbur and Eliza, who are the smartest kids around when they put their heads together. Events threaten to keep the twins apart and a Chinese ambassador needs the twins' help.

Title: 314. Rajput
description: Unable to handle the taking of his kingdom by an Indian Government decree, the Maharaja kills himself. His son, Jaipal, takes over as the Maharaja, turns rebel, and refuses to hand over his title and kingdom to the Government. It is in this background that Police Superintendent Dhirendra Singh assumes his duties. When a conflict arises between Jaipal and himself, he is transferred to another town. His father, Thakur Ram Avtaar, wants him to marry a childhood friend, Janki, the daughter of Thakur Pratap Singh. When he meets her, he falls in love with her, not knowing that she has given her heart to Manu Pratap Singh, with whose family there is animosity as Pratap's sister had eloped with a male from their family, & was killed at the hands of Pratap. An enraged Pratap, when he finds out about Janki's affair, has her married to Dhirendra. On the day of the marriage, Jaipal's nephew abducts Janki, but is shot dead by Manu. A pregnant Janki goes to live with Dhirendra, while Manu is sentenced to prison for life. An angry Jaipal kills Manu's dad, Thakur Sangram Singh, and sets fire to their house. Then Jaipal sets his eyes on young Kamli, who is Bhanu Pratap Singh's, Manu's brother, sweetheart, gets her pregnant, but refuses to marry her. Kamli, shamed at this, refuses to meet Bhanu. When Bhanu finds out that Jaipal had killed his dad and set fire to their property, he becomes a bandit with several other townspeople, and calls himself Bhavani. Years later, Manu is released from prison for good conduct, decides to make a living as a bounty hunter, hunting down, killing bandits and collecting rewards from SP Dhirendra. The story reaches a climax when Manu goes to hunt down Bhawani, not knowing that it is his own brother; while Jaipal kidnaps Dhirendra's son and holds him for ransom. The question remains will Manu hunt down Bhanu, and will Dhirendra compromise his position for a child that is not his own?

Title: 315. The Jonsson Gang & Dynamite Harry
description: Sickan, Vanheden and Rocky try to rob the Berns nightclub one night, but Vanheden has made the mistake to invite his constantly drunk cousin, the old dynamiter Dynamite-Harry and he ruins the plan. Sickan is arrested, and has to spend 10 months in a small, locked room. When he is released, he has a new plan, but Rocky and Vanheden have decided to go straight. Together with Dynamite-Harry, Sickan plans to rob a cold store, managed by their arch-enemy, Wall-Enberg.

Title: 316. Human Highway
description: The new owner of a roadside diner stuck in a town built around an always leaking nuclear power plant plans to torch the place to collect insurance. However, an assortment of bizare characters and weird events (such as spaceships flying around) gets in his way.

Title: 317. Double Exposure
description: A photographer plagued by horrific nightmares in which he kills the young female models he shoots is shocked to discover that there is a serial killer in his city who is targeting attractive women.

Title: 318. Ninja Wars
description: During the Sengoku era, while scheming how to win the wife of his master, Lady Ukyo (Noriko Watanabe), Danjo Matsunaga (Akira Nakao) sends a group of dark magic monks to attack the lover of ninja Fuefuki Jotaro (Hiroyuki Sanada), named Kagaribi (Noriko Watanabe, in 3 roles). She happens to be the sister of Lady Ukyo (Noriko Watanabe). However, choosing death over shame, Kagaribi commits suicide. After learning of this, Jotaro vows revenge, and challenges the mastermind behind all the plotting and scheming: the illusionist Kashin (Narita Mikio), in a battle for the ages.

Title: 319. Death of a Ninja
description: A fortuneteller prophesizes that whoever marries the beautiful Ukio will become the ruler of the world. Naturally, this makes her very popular with those vying for power, particularly the insatiably greedy Lord Donjo. Only the ninja Jotaro can stop Donjo's plan, but to do so, he must first battle the deadly team of "Devil Monks" serving the lord. Will Jotaro succeed in his mission? And if so, will Ukio marry him, thus making him the ruler of the world?

Title: 320. Young Girlfriends Looking for Pleasure
description: The deputy and the mayor of Alfajarón spend the weekend in a chalet, where, together with a lesbian friend, they engage in swinging.

Title: 321. Boat People
description: A Japanese photojournalist revisits Vietnam after the Liberation and learns harsh truths about its regime and its "New Economic Zones".

Title: 322. The Passerby
description: Being imprisoned for murdering a politician, husband tells his wife why he did this.

Title: 324. Island of Blood
description: A group of actors are assembled in a small island to film a low-budget movie. Soon, they begin to fall prey to a mysterious killer who uses the lyrics of a weird song to determine his method of murder.

Title: 325. Cold River
description: Follows an Adirondack guide, his daughter, and stepson on a 1932 camping trip cut short by early winter. Stranded without food or shelter, the children must find their way home amidst the harsh winterkill conditions.

Title: 326. Nomad
description: Two young couples, from the wealthy and working class of Hong Kong, form and soon become inseparable. They start living an idle life, dreaming of traveling far away, when an ex-revolutionary friend in hiding arrives from Japan.

Title: 327. A Room in Town
description: Amid an ongoing workers' strike, a steelworker falls in love with the daughter of his baroness landlady, even though both are already in relationships.

Title: 328. The Quack
description: Abandoned by his wife and daughter, a famous surgeon starts drinking, hurts his head and loses his memory. His medical knowledge gradually resurfaces and he becomes a village healer, not remembering who he is.

Title: 329. Running on Empty
description: Mike is a young man who is a budding street racer, and owner of a Ford Falcon GT-HO Phase III. His best mate and mechanic, Tony, are both steel workers by day, but when they aren't working, they are racing.

Title: 330. Hablamos esta noche
description: Víctor, the engineer responsible for the Zapater nuclear power plant, joins his professional problems with an imminent divorce, a homosexual son and a new relationship. When a few days remain for the inauguration of the plant, an engineer very friendly to Víctor, guilty of a serious work-related accident and alcoholic, warns him of the possibility of a failure in the operation of the plant. Nothing guarantees the veracity of this warning, but to find out, the inauguration must be suspended.

Title: 331. All Fired Up
description: Pauline, a minister's assistant, has been looking after her 2 sisters and grandma when her charming, gambling dad returns to Paris after 15 years abroad. Pauline suspects, he's after their grandma's money.

Title: 332. Malamore
description: Marcello is a dwarf who is kept hidden by his family and falls in love with a prostitute from the local brothel. The prostitute's lover plots to kill the dwarf but she helps him to escape, though at a cost to her own well-being.

Title: 333. Hysterical
description: A burned out writer retreats to a northwest town called Hellview to write the great American novel. Unfortunately for him, the lighthouse he is renting is inhabited by the spirit of a woman who killed herself there one hundred years before and now wants him to replace her lost love, Captain Howdy. When Captain Howdy is resurrected, two daring adventure seekers are brought in to solve the case and find out the secret of the lighthouse.

Title: 334. Starstruck
description: A teenage girl, with dreams of becoming a famous singer, tries to secure a spot on a local televised talent show.

Title: 335. Chambal Ke Daku
description: Two real life dacoits of Chambal, Mohar Singh and Madho Singh starred in this film.

Title: 336. Burst City
description: Punk rock gangs and music groups clash with one another and the brutal police force in a futuristic Tokyo setting.

Title: 337. I'm Looking for a Bed
description: Three privileged young women escape their controlling families and move to São Paulo. Living in a tenement house, they navigate city life and unexpected romance while pursuing their independence.

Title: 338. Ferat Vampire
description: An unusual vehicle, the vampire-mobile owned by Madam Ferat, draws blood from the driver's foot via a fanged gas pedal, using it as fuel to keep the car running during acceleration.

Title: 340. The Ghost Dance
description: The spirit of a long-dead warrior possesses the body of an Indian medicine man and turns him into a homicidal maniac.

Title: 341. Ace of Aces
description: In 1936, a French boxer on his way to the Berlin Olympic Games befriends a local Jewish boy and decides to save him from the Nazis.

Title: 342. White Rose Campus: Then Everybody Gets Raped
description: Three crazed rapists hijack a school bus and proceed to terrorize and rape all the teachers and students they feel are attractive enough.

Title: 343. Female Teacher Hunting
description: A high-school student and her boyfriend go skinny-dipping on a warm night. Soon the boy is being accused of committing a violent sexual assault on the girl. Enraged, he knocks down a female teacher and storms out of the school. He spends the summer in a beach town and finds himself mixed up in a dark world of sex and violence.

Title: 345. Sablazan
description: In the end of World War II young partisan falls in love with German secretary who is captured and imprisoned by partisans. He decides to free her and escape with her

Title: 346. Moondru Mugham
description: A sincere police officer is killed by a liquor dealer. Years later, his twin sons set out to avenge their father's death.

Title: 347. Yavanika
description: An infamous tabla player of a touring drama group goes missing. Later on, Sub-inspector Jacob Eeraly investigates the case.

Title: 348. Amici miei - Atto II°
description: The four old friends meet on the grave of the fifth of them, Perozzi, who died at the end of the first episode. Time has passed but they are still up for adventures and cruel jokes, and while they recall the one they created together with the late friend, new ones are on their way, starting right there at the cemetery.

Title: 349. The Hunters of the Golden Cobra
description: An American soldier and a British intelligence agent try to track down an ancient relic called the Golden Cobra, rumored to have supernatural powers.

Title: 350. Emanuelle in the Country
description: When Emanuelle (Gemser) arrives in the small Italian village heads start turning and eyes start popping. All males in the town are falling all over themselves trying to get a look (or a feel) of the new doctor. One in particular is the fiancee of the mayor's daughter. A kind of "Hatfield's and McCoy's" feud with a political twist has been going on and the young lovers' families are, unfortunately, on opposite sides. Emanuelle's shower becomes the target of a gang of voyeurs, including the pillars of the community. She uses it as a stage to taunt the watchers to charge into her apartment on the notion that she is showering with the mayor's daughter's fiancee. Instead of what they expected, they find the two young lovers in bed. Can Emanuelle shame them into allowing the marriage that they had been preventing?

Title: 351. La balance
description: Police compel a couple of criminals to become its informants.

Title: 352. Sex and Willingly
description: Ten segments, all starring Johnny Dorelli and all having sex and sexual perversions as main theme.

Title: 353. Batch '81
description: The lives of seven neophytes as they strive to enter a Greek letter fraternity through a difficult hazing process. The entire experience is seen through the eyes of Sid Lucero, one of the neophytes.

Title: 354. The Wizard of Oz
description: Animated version of the classic story of a young farmgirl who is transported to the magic land of Oz.

Title: 355. Attila
description: The misadventures of Attila and his band of barbarians as they take up arms against the Roman Empire in their native Milano.

Title: 356. Blood Song
description: A psychopath escapes from a mental institution and starts a murder spree, which ends in the pursuing of a young handicapped girl, who once got a blood transfusion from him.

Title: 357. Incontro nell'ultimo paradiso
description: Two college students decide to take a vacation to the Amazon. After renting a boat and sailing down the river in search of some good scenery, the two kids become lost.

Title: 358. A Time to Die
description: In the final days of World War II, American spy Michael Rogan (Edward Albert Jr.) is taken prisoner, along with his wife and comrades from the French underground. A sadistic six-man interrogation team fails to get any information out of Rogan, and brutally murder his wife and fellow conspirators, shoot him, and leave him for dead. After the war, Rogan sets out on a mission of bloodshed and terror that takes him across Europe. Haunted, wounded, and relentlessly driven by his hatred and his memory, Rogan avenges the senseless murders, one by one. The leader of the interrogating team and Rogan's ultimate target is Von Osten (Rex Harrison), now a major political force in post-war Germany. Von Osten is on the verge of gaining the Chancellery and becoming a puppet for the Americans. Rogan carefully stalks his prey, dodging American agents and tensely awaiting his chance. In the final confrontation, Rogan must face both his memory and his tormentor, but it is Von Osten that must stare into the steely eyes of hatred and look justice square in the face.

Title: 359. Khud-Daar
description: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.

Title: 360. Bingo Bongo
description: A monkey like man found in the jungles of Congo is brought to Milan, Italy and is called Bingo Bongo. Only Laura, an anthropologist, believes in his human qualities.

Title: 361. The Hatter's Ghost
description: Labbé is a quiet hatter in a small town, living with his handicapped wife who never goes out. His neighbour, a tailor, is fascinated by him. A series of female murders shakes the town. Is Labbé involved?

Title: 362. Vortex
description: A film noirish atmosphere is created to show detective Lunch (a popular underground musician and poet) plow her way through the plans of a corporate businessman who seeks government defense contracts through real "corporate wars" and the manipulation of politicians.

Title: 363. All by Myself: The Eartha Kitt Story
description: Documentary profile of singer-actress Eartha Kitt.

Title: 365. I Are You, You Am Me
description: 9th-graders Kazuo (boy) and Kazumi (girl) take a tumble at a temple in a small seacoast town in Japan. Through supernatural intervention, their minds and bodies are switched, and the result is a touching and hilarious coming-of-age comedy as they attempt to survive the pressures of junior high school life.

Title: 366. Le choc
description: An assassin tries to retire against his bosses' will.

Title: 367. Monkey Grip
description: A frank portrayal of a year in the life of a divorced mother living in Melbourne, trying to cope with her daughter and her own relationship with a drug addict while trying to get into the music business.

Title: 368. Espion, lève-toi
description: Sébastien Grenier, a French sleeper agent in Switzerland, is contacted after eight years of silence after the murder of an other mole. But he doubts the identity of the person who presents himself as his superior.

Title: 369. The Clairvoyant
description: Two uneasy friends, a police officer and a TV talk show host, each pursue the mysterious "handcuff killer" with the aid of an artist who sees - and draws - the killer's crimes before they're committed.

Title: 370. El regreso de Eva Man
description: Eva, Ajita and Professor Pissinger fighting against a gang of criminals, who want to steal a gun from them which, when aimed at people, fills them with uncontrollable sexual desire.

Title: 371. Mobile Suit Gundam III: Encounters in Space
description: Amuro Ray's White Base crew, now the 13th Autonomous Corps, rejoin the Earth Federation forces in space for the climactic battle against the Duchy of Zeon's military.

Title: 372. Les sous-doués en vacances
description: After their adventures in high school, the group of under-gifted friends plan how to spend their summer vacation.

Title: 373. Are We?
description: Based on a work by Eduardo Gudiño, A young man falls in love with a woman who lives in the cemetery of the neighborhood - small, but very important - of La Recoleta in Buenos Aires and who will turn out to be his mother.

Title: 375. Spring Fever
description: Tough girl from Vegas (Carling Bassett) travels to Florida with her promiscuous mother (Susan Anton) to compete in the Junior Nationals Women's Tennis championship.

Title: 376. Honeymoon Horror
description: Imagine every newlywed's fantasy, a rustic secluded lover's paradise- Honeymoon Island. What starts as a weekend of love, turns into a nightmare of blood and terror for three young innocent couples. What lurks in the shadows of Honeymoon Lodge? Is it the caretaker, or perhaps something more fiendish and deadly? Honeymoon Island, where newlyweds joined in holy matrimony spend their wedding night screaming in terror!

Title: 377. Freedom
description: Ron, a young man in his late teens or early 20s, but emotionally younger, has no visible, employable assets, yet rails at his status in life -- blaming everyone for the fact that his dreams are not coming true.

Title: 378. Bloody Sect
description: A young woman pregnant with the Anti-Christ is terrorized by a cult of satanists.

Title: 379. Three Crowns of the Sailor
description: A drunken sailor recounts the surrealistic odyssey of his life story to a murderous student.

Title: 380. Buddha's Palm
description: A lowly young man is saved by a flying creature, which takes him to his blind master's cave. There, he learns a formidable form of martial arts, and goes on a fantastical journey facing weird powers and dredging up old grudges.

Title: 381. We of the Never Never
description: Jeannie Gunn faced being the only civilised woman in an uncivilised land. A story of personal triumph about one woman who reached out in a hard, hostile, prejudiced world and managed to find love.

Title: 382. Paradis pour tous
description: Dr. Valois develops "flashage" to treat depression. After testing on monkeys, he cures patient Alain Durieux. His wife fears personality changes as more seek treatment. Untreated subjects reject treated ones. Valois uses it on himself.

Title: 383. A Noite das Taras II
description: 2 stories: 1. A troubled bank clerk with violin aspirations leads a double life as a serial killer, haunted by childhood trauma. 2. A female gang's robbery attempt turns into an unexpected encounter with an adult film star.

Title: 384. The Scorpion with Two Tails
description: Joan has nightmares of Etruscan sacrifices. She knows very well the Etruscan language and her husband Arthur is an archeologist studying Etruscan tombs. In a nightmare she foresees her husband's death. And Arthur is then killed with the same way the Etruscans killed their sacrifice victims.

Title: 386. Sturmtruppen 2 (tutti al fronte)
description: A group of misfits form an army in an absurd war.

Title: 387. Baker County, U.S.A.
description: When a group of college students come across a redneck in the wilderness murdering his wife's lover, they become the objects of his crazed vengeance.

Title: 388. Deux heures moins le quart avant Jésus-Christ
description: Rahatlocum is a North African Roman colony where Julius Caesar came to spend an expensive holiday. The revolt rumbles among the small people who find a leader in the person of Ben-Hur Marcel.

Title: 389. Ricchi, ricchissimi... praticamente in mutande
description: During a trial we discover the stories of three really unlucky characters.

Title: 390. My Pastor Among the Nudists
description: In a village abandoned by its inhabitants, the local parish priest, very classic for these times, is sent by his diocese to a nudist campsite.

Title: 391. Pure Blood
description: Roberto Hurtado, a rich old man suffers from a blood disease, so he requires transfusions of a rare type of blood from young men. His son Adolfo blackmails the nurse and two drivers, involved in a sexual crime, to get the blood kidnapping, killing and stealing the blood of their victims, which raises terror throughout Cali.

Title: 392. Oro, Plata, Mata
description: Two affluent families struggle and learn to survive during the Japanese occupation in the Philippines.

Title: 393. Pepeng Kaliwete
description: Pepe returns to his hometown as a worker of a sugarcane plantation with the aim of avenging the death of his father but he rises to become the town police chief.

Title: 394. O'Hara's Wife
description: A mourning workaholic's deceased wife comes back to haunt him, but in a benevolent way, trying to get him to change his dreary attorney life into a life where he has a relationship with his children and is happier with himself.

Title: 395. Voyager from the Unknown
description: This film consists of two tales of time travel, combining science fiction characters with actual historical figures. Hexum stars as Phineas Bogg, a time traveler who teams up with an orphan named Jeff. They visit important people from history as they try to get home, while at the same time not altering the path of history.

Title: 396. Arcadia of My Youth
description: Space captain Harlock, the latest in a family of proud aerial warriors, begins his journey to free the oppressed Earth from the despotic Illumidas Command.

Title: 397. The White Rose
description: During the Second World War, a small group of students at Munich University begin to question the decisions and sanity of Germany's Nazi government. The students form a resistance cell which they name the "White Rose" after a newsletter that is secretly distributed to the student body. At first small in numbers and fearful of discovery, the White Rose begins to gain massive support after a Nazi Gauleiter nearly incites a student riot after a provocative speech. At this point, the matter is taken over by the Gestapo, who pledge to hunt down and destroy the members of the White Rose.

Title: 398. Bazaar
description: A young man challenges traditional customs by standing up to the father of the woman he loves, who has promised her to a wealthy expatriate.

Title: 399. Prem Rog
description: Manorama, the daughter of a rich, orthodox family is married off, leaving her childhood friend Deodhar and his secret love for her, in despair. When tragedy befalls her, and traditions seem unfair, Deodhar must fight for what's right.

Title: 400. In Our Time
description: Four short films from four different directors, spanning from the 1950s to the 1980s.

Title: 401. Kiss My Grits
description: A man heads for Mexico with a mobster's girlfriend.

Title: 402. Samanka
description: Young and sexy European fashion models are abducted to an isolated place (Ceylon), locked up, stripped, sexually abused and tortured by powerful, sadistic men.

Title: 403. Madam Scandal: Let Me Die for 10 Seconds
description: Midori Satsuki plays Megumi, a woman who runs a Japanese-style restaurant called "Meg" in in Los Angeles, California. The film follows her erotic adventures.

Title: 404. Splitz
description: An all-female rock band and a group of "well-endowed" sorority sisters team up to save a sorority house slated for condemnation by the university.

Title: 405. Invaders of the Lost Gold
description: Japanese WWII soldiers stash a gold treasure in a cave in the Philippines' forest after being attacked by a native tribe. Decades later, a ragtag team sets out to retrieve the gold.

Title: 406. Porca vacca
description: When a stage artist is sent to fight he meets a lovely girl.

Title: 407. The Miracle Fighters
description: A condemned Manchurian commander escapes by taking the emperor's boy as hostage. 14 years later, the emperor's evil sorcerer finally learns of his whereabouts, now living with a young man who wears the emperor's boy's jade necklace.

Title: 408. Begin the Beguine
description: A renowned Spanish writer returns to his natal city after 40 years and embarks on a journey back to his roots, triggering memories of his past.

Title: 409. Talcum Powder
description: Sergio Benvenuti finds a job as musical agent to an important Italian publisher. This could be his final step before to marry Rossella. But his career does not rise, so he asks Nadia Vandelli, a more-experienced agent and a nice girl, to work with him for just one day to gain more experience. They must meet Manuel Fantoni in his own flat; Nadia is late, but Sergio goes ahead with the meeting. By the time she arrives, Sergio has found out that Fantoni isn't what he said he was. Things escalate quickly until Sergio lands in an incredible situation from which he can't escape.

Title: 410. Death of Yazdgerd
description: Death of Yazdgerd is the story of death of the last king of Iran before Muslims invade Iran. He escapes to city of Marv and hides in a mill but finally gets killed. The Story is told by the miller, his wife and his daughter but all the stories are different from each other.

Title: 411. The Prefab People
description: A husband and wife, drifting apart, reflect on the events leading up to the worst argument of their marriage.

Title: 412. La gorilla
description: Ruby has been trained in martial arts by her father and now has a job safeguarding a wide range of people and their valuables. A clumsy artist named Adelmo falls for Ruby at first sight but remains clueless about her profession. Things are complicated by Adelmo's French neighbor and sometime model having a crush on him, and Ruby's father trying to hook up his daughter with various body builders while putting the moves on the French girl.

Title: 413. The Big Pardon
description: With the help of his binoculars, commissioner Duche monitors from his car the reception at the villa of Raymond Bettoun, the head of the clan of Jewish Pied-Noir.

Title: 414. The Trout
description: Frederique (Huppert) leaves her family's small-town trout farm to embark on an journey taking her to Japan and into the arms of a man. Irritations concerning her actions and present state of feelings begin to fill her mind, forcing her to come to terms with innermost self.

Title: 415. Les Misérables
description: The story of Jean Valjean, a Frenchman convicted of minor crimes, who is hounded for years by an unforgiving and unrelenting police inspector, Javert.

Title: 416. Soup for One
description: When Allan meets Maria he is sure he has found the perfect woman for him but she's not interested. He persists, she relents, they begin dating. Allan then starts to second guess what he thought he wanted.

Title: 417. The Treasure Planet
description: A villain wants to stop the crew from getting to a gem that will bring life back to earth

Title: 418. Shao Lin nian si liu ma
description: The Wu Tang seek to destroy the Shaolin Temple. The monks of Shaolin pin their hopes on a lone disciple to hold back the Wu horde. Training him are various teachers, including two crippled masters.

Title: 420. Fair Game
description: Three wealthy schoolgirls escape for a weekend getaway to a remote town, unaware it's been overtaken by psychopaths who stalk and terrorize them, turning their vacation into a horrific nightmare.

Title: 421. Gräsänklingar
description: Gary misses the bus. He doesn't have a car.

Title: 422. Biancaneve & Co...
description: The king and the queen conceive Snow White during a sexual relationship in the snow.

Title: 423. Doosra Roop
description: A woman, raped by three men, commits suicide. She is reincarnated as a dog and takes revenge from her rapists, from her past life.

Title: 424. Nikaah
description: After an unsuccessful marriage, Niloufer gets married to Haider, an editor, and eventually falls in love with him. However, soon her marriage bliss ends when her ex-husband Wasim returns in her life.

Title: 425. Waltz Across Texas
description: A cosmopolitan East Coast geologist (Anne Archer) drills for oil and finds love with a Texas wildcatter (Terry Jastrow).

Title: 426. Fall Guy
description: A lowly obsequious member of a movie star's entourage agrees to marry his boss's pregnant mistress so he can continue his feckless lifestyle. He then takes up dangerous work as a stunt man to support his new family. Duty and loyalty turn into something deeper.

Title: 427. Pecado Horizontal
description: In a small town, three men meet after 15 years for a wedding and, instead of attending the ceremony, they go to a bar and start remembering the past, along with their sexual adventures.

Title: 429. He Who Doesn't Run, Flies!
description: After mistakenly going to jail, Maria makes friends with a woman whose kids live in the streets and Maria gets the idea to help them.

Title: 430. Bemisal
description: 'Bemisal' is the story of noble orphan Sudhir, who sacrifices everything he has, from the love of his life to his profession and reputation, to save his foster family.

Title: 431. Family Relations
description: A woman from the countryside comes to the city to visit her only daughter and granddaughter. She is hopelessly lost in this world she does not understand.

Title: 432. Die liebestollen Lederhosen
description: Franz Mooshuber, mayor of a little Bavarian town, receives a letter invitation from the mayor of Cannes, asking him to participate in the annual boat joust tournament. When he and his two buddies return, they don't just bring back the trophy but also a bus full of sexy girls and ambitious plans to turn their village into a wild tourist resort.

Title: 433. The Eyes, the Mouth
description: A burned-out actor returns to his provincial hometown after his twin brother's death by suicide. While trying to make his mother believe that it was an accident, he meets the deceased's fiance, sparking a mutual attraction.

Title: 434. BrainWaves
description: After a traffic accident Kaylie is in coma for months. Her doctors want to try a new procedure on her: to regain her consciousness, they stimulate her brain with neural patterns of a woman who just died. It works, and Kaylie seems to be ok again. However in her dreams, she lives the last day of her savor - and realizes that she's been killed! Together with her husband she tries to find out what happened.

Title: 435. Grand Hotel Excelsior
description: Taddeus is the manager of the Grand Hotel Excelsior. Since the Summer season started in May, many people have swarmed to the hotel: Ilde Vivaldi, in love with Taddeus; and the boxer Pericle Coccia who has an important match and falls in love with Maria. There is the Mago di Segrate, trying to win world fame by levitating 30 meters high. And there is the waiter Egisto whose daughter is in a Swiss college believing her father is a man of importance.

Title: 436. Lovers Lost
description: A love story between a 29-year-old woman, who has once been a prostitute but is now the mistress of a wealthy jewelry merchant, and a 19-year-old college student.

Title: 437. Mongrel
description: At a boarding house, a vicious dog gets loose from his chain and chews up a tenant's ass that was teasing him with a piece of raw meat. As a result, the dog is shot to death. Another tenant, a very high strung book editor, is picked on alot. Soon he starts having dreams that the dog has returned and dead chewed up tenants begin popping up everywhere.

Title: 438. Menuet
description: A factory worker at a brewery spends his free time collecting pictures of wildflowers, while murders and violent acts unfold around him.

Title: 439. La colmena
description: As in the novel of the same title from Camilo Jose Cela, "La Colmena" is a sad composition with the stories of many people in the Madrid of 1942, just the postwar of the spanish civil war. The main theme of the film is the contrast between the poets, surviving close to misery under the Franco's regime, and the winners of the war, the emerging class of the people that makes easy money with illegal business.

Title: 440. Nutcracker
description: A Russian ballet dancer defects from the U.S.S.R., emigrates to England, and joins a ballet company run by a powerful, wealthy lady (Dame Joan Collins).

Title: 441. Karina, Objeto do Prazer
description: Young woman has many love affairs, after killing her husband.

Title: 442. Anokha Bandhan
description: Shyamlal has a happy family with his wife Anu, and step-brother Ram. Anu take care of Ram as her own son. Anu's mother came to her house, who wants that Anu should hate Ram. This creates rift between Anu and Ram.

Title: 443. Safari 3000
description: Reporter J.J. Dalton (Stockard Channing) wants to write a story about a gruelling three thousand-kilometer auto rally through Africa. After her deal to ride with a driver falls through, she hires ex-stuntman Eddie Miles (David Carradine), who is racing against his former employer, the ruthless Count Borgia (Sir Christopher Lee), who becomes their hardest and meanest competitor in the rally. Borgia and his sidekick Feodor (Hamilton Camp) do all they can to thwart the other drivers, but luck and love are on J.J. and Eddie's side.

Title: 444. La plaça del Diamant
description: The life of a young woman in Barcelona during the Spanish Civil War and its aftermath.

Title: 445. Fake-Out
description: Gangster's girlfriend hangs out in a Las Vegas hotel with her cop protectors while she waits to testify.

Title: 446. Burned at the Stake
description: In 1692 in Salem, Massachusetts, young Ann Putnam accuses several residents of being witches, and they are tried and put to death. In 1980, young Loreen Graham is on a school outing to the Salem Witch Museum when a wax figure of a man from 1692 comes to life and accosts her. It seems that she may be the reincarnation of Ann, who has accused the man's 5-year-old girl of witchcraft and the girl is scheduled to be burned at the stake. Loreen must fight being possessed by Ann Putnam and confront the evil minister from 1692 who is consorting with Ann to falsely accuse people of witchcraft.

Title: 447. S.A.S. San Salvador
description: CIA agent Malko Linge is tasked with eliminating Enrique Chacon, the man behind the assassination of a Catholic archbishop. Along the way, he encounters femme fatales and dangerous adversaries.

Title: 448. As Safadas
description: In 1970s São Paulo, 3 separate tales unfold: a pinball champion faces relationship drama, a woman's revenge plot takes a dark turn when she discovers her neighbor's secret, and a bride-to-be with a double life must protect her reputation.

Title: 449. A Reencarnação do Sexo
description: A father kills his daughter's lover to end their romance. After a sleepwalking episode leads to a macabre discovery, tragedy strikes. Years later, new tenants move into the house, where restless spirits seek revenge.

Title: 450. Electric Blue the Movie
description: A compilation of clips taken from the 'Electric Blue' series of video tapes, featuring varying sexual content.

Title: 451. Shocking Africa
description: A look at the fast disappearing tribal customs of North Africa.

Title: 452. Love Child
description: The true story of Terry Jean Moore, a young woman who is imprisoned for 7 years on account of a "five dollar" robbery. In prison she gets pregnant by a jailer and has to fight to keep her child.

Title: 453. Baghavat
description: During a drought, Maharaj Singh is killed by officials who disobey his relief orders. His wife and son Amar escape with Sher Khan's help. Raised by gypsies, grown Amar falls for his enemy's sister before facing death by elephant.

Title: 454. Dögkeselyü
description: Two old women who happen to be pickpockets stole money from Simon, the taxi driver. The police are unable to find the thieves, so Simon decides to find them himself.

Title: 455. Mighty Mouse in the Great Space Chase
description: Space cat villain Harry the Heartless holds space mouse Queen Pureheart. Only Mighty Mouse can save her.

Title: 456. Runaway Nightmare
description: Two dorky Nevada worm wranglers are kidnapped by a gang of beautiful women as part of a plot to steal plutonium from the Mafia.

Title: 457. Abbas in Flower
description: Abbas is the assistant of Sakir who is a rogue guy, and Abbas has a dream which is to buy a minibus for his own.

Title: 458. Vijeta
description: Angad is a confused teenager trying to find himself and is caught in between the marital problems of his Maharashtrian mother Neelima and Punjabi fat.

Title: 459. A Dangerous Summer
description: When a crummy hotel burns down in Australia, the American co-owner tries to find out whether or not the fire was deliberately set or just an accident.

Title: 460. Like Rabbits
description: It tells a story set in a recreational area, where two different boys, Petr and Michal, become friends after an initial mutual distrust.

Title: 461. Lost Youth
description: Myeong-ja has dreams of becoming a wealthy woman and she'll achieve them in any way that she can. She gets her opportunity when she meets Woo-shik. Myeong-ja seduces him, then goes to meet his father. She claims that she will file rape charges unless she receives a considerable payoff

Title: 462. Reifeprüfung auf der Schulbank
description: A ladies man gets a new job as a physical education teacher for high school students.

Title: 463. Legendary Weapons of China
description: A few assassins from different martial arts schools, all belonging to a special branch that practices a supernatural form of kung fu, are sent on a manhunt for a former high ranking member of their society.

Title: 464. Calamity of Snakes
description: After a businessman kills thousands of snakes in a pit where they are building a new apartment building, the residents of the building are attacked by thousands of snakes as vengeance.

Title: 465. Bankers Also Have Souls
description: Gregoire is retiring after many years with the same bank, and his collegues surprise him with the gift of a beautiful call girl, Barbara. Thinking she is a conquest, he impersonates the bank president, leading to a comedy of mistaken identities.

Title: 466. Gauche the Cellist
description: A cellist in a small orchestra receives help from animals to help him practice his music.

Title: 467. Purple Haze
description: The film opens in Princeton University, 1968, where Matt Caulfield and his friends are watching television. There, they witness President Lyndon B. Johnson inform us of his plans not to rerun in the upcoming election. Upon hearing of his plans, Matt and the rest of the students celebrate by smoking marijuana. An uncool student from next door is disturbed by the boys' racket, and upon being pelted with junk food by the boys for telling them to be quiet, he calls the police. Within minutes, Matt and his roommates are caught smoking, and are banned from college campus. Matt returns home to his family, where he is faced with various issues before being shipped off to Vietnam.

Title: 468. Jimmy the Kid
description: Gang of bumbling crooks kidnap a bratty little kid, find out they got more than they bargained for.

Title: 469. Légitime violence
description: A man whose family were killed during an attempted robbery in a railway station decides to take the law into his own hands when the police do not track down the killers.

Title: 470. Hex After Hex
description: Immediately picking up from the ending of Hex vs. Witchcraft (1980), the muscular neighbor refuses to marry the female ghost, so she decides to possess the body a girl he's in love with, after causing a car crash which kills her.

Title: 471. Ghazab
description: Ajay alias Munna Babu is a semi-senile, gentle but naive young man who has a wealthy family estate. His employees and alleged well-wishers (Arjun Singh, Jatha Shankar, Munishi Gurbachan, Bhairav) conspire against him and introduce him to his long-estranged mother, Shakuntala, and brother, Vijay. Munna is overjoyed, not knowing that they are devious impersonators. This joy is quite short-lived, as they soon show their true colors, and Munna gets killed. His restless spirit seeks out his real brother and appeals to him to avenge his death. Vijay, at first, thinks he is hallucinating, but when his mother confirms that he indeed had a twin brother, he agrees to accompany Munna's spirit back to where he was killed, and thus assist him complete his vengeance. Things do not go as planned, and Vijay himself becomes their victim, and may face the very same fate as Munna.

Title: 472. Sawaal
description: Sawaal is a powerful confrontation of life's greatest motivating forces - self against selfishness, love against power, good against evil.

Title: 473. Le notti segrete di Lucrezia Borgia
description: A thief captures Duke of Riviera, decides to impersonate him and head to Rome.

Title: 474. Brothers from the Walled City
description: When a gambling boss named Chen Yuan Lung ends up dead, he leaves his two sons, Chia Chin and Chia Kang in the custody of his good buddy Chiptooth.

Title: 475. Breezes of Love
description: Two actresses and politician traveling and staying in the same hotel, but each has a distinct purpose.

Title: 476. Sweet Hours
description: The past is a riddle to Juan, the playwright. He is tormented by it - by memories of the elderly father who went off, and the young mother who committed suicide, and he has written a play which contains the key scenes of his early life.

Title: 477. Big Meat Eater
description: Strange events occur in a small town after a mild mannered butcher hires an unusual apprentice.

Title: 478. Red Bells
description: A chronicle of the Russian and Mexican revolutions in the early 20th century.

Title: 479. Ego... kai to pouli mou
description: A struggling photo-reporter who works for a weekly gossip magazine will somehow entangle himself in the plans of an international antiquities-trafficking ring, as he tails an illegal couple in Limassol.

Title: 480. Privileged
description: A story about a group of Oxford undergraduate acting students and their troubled lives while producing (and competing between themselves for a role in) a different version of the classic play "The Duchess of Malfi". Love, friendship and rivalry are all part of this intricate project, filmed on actual location in the Oxford University, the very first to achieve such feat.

Title: 481. Irezumi
description: To satisfy her lover's fetish for tattooed women, Akane agrees to have her body covered in eloborate tattoos by Kyogoro, an old craftsman. Kyogoro has developed a special technique, by which his assistant, Harutsune, keeps Katsuko's mind off the pain while Kyogoro does his work. After the work is done, Harutsune makes the shocking discovery of how Kyogoro mastered his technique.

Title: 482. Bir Yudum Mutluluk
description: Orhan and Zehra wants to get married but have no money. Orhan goes to Germany to work for two years to save money for the wedding. When he return to Turkey he finds Zehra in bad company.

Title: 483. Desh Premee
description: Master Dinanath is an ex-freedom fighter.
