description: The playwright Oskar Panizza was imprisoned by a Bavarian court in 1895 and committed to an insane asylum in 1904, for the rest of his life. The film covers his trial and a performance of his play.

Title: 785. En flicka på halsen
description: A good-natured lab assistant becomes the caretaker of a young girl, who one night is randomly left in his apartment by her father, for reasons unknown to him.

Title: 786. Al sur del edén
description: Three girls, of different walks of life, bond in a holiday resort as they deal with prostitution, gambling addiction, a junkie boyfriend, a ruthless pimp and a summer romance that is not meant to last.

Title: 787. Cuando calienta el sol... vamos a la playa
description: An amateur boxer goes on holiday.

Title: 788. Hong fen bing tuan
description: A group of women with various criminal skills are thrown into prison during World War 2. They escape and proceed to head off to destroy a chemical lab in a well fortified valley.

Title: 789. The Guns and the Fury
description: Two turn of the Century fortune hunters (Peter Graves and Cameron Mitchell) discover oil in Persia and attempt to claim it. Serious resistance is met.

Title: 790. Beijo na Boca
description: Middle-class girl gets involved with a jealous drug dealer, who wants to kill all of her previous boyfriends.

Title: 791. The Case Is Closed
description: The servant boy, a minor, engaged in a middle class family dies mysteriously locked in a kitchen.

Title: 792. La pulquería 2
description: The devil returns to earth in search of a cure for his loss of masculinity.

Title: 793. He Lives by Night
description: A killer wears women's clothing and stalks others that wear fish-net stockings.

Title: 794. Dead Easy
description: Three young friends trying to break into the entertainment business inadvertently anger a mob boss, setting in motion a chain of events that results in their being hunted by every thug and killer in town.

Title: 795. El diablo en persona
description: A quarrelsome gambler take part in the revolution to avoid a marriage that is forced upon him.

Title: 796. They Call It an Accident
description: A woman tries to come to terms with the death of her son, who was killed by a hospital error.

Title: 797. Waidmannsheil im Spitzenhöschen
description: A count is experiencing financial problems. He rents his hunting place to tourists to earn some extra cash. Curiously enough, all guests seem not to be interested in hunting, but in sex.

Title: 798. Miris dunja
description: Thanks to his friendliness towards the Germans, a Sarajevo businessman becomes increasingly wealthy during World War II. However, his infatuation with a Jewish girl will cause his demise.

Title: 799. Puppy Love
description: YOUNGSTERS PROVE THAT PUPPY LOVE IS NOT LESS TRUE AND SINCERE THAN THAT OF THE ELDERS.

Title: 800. Ghost Nursing
description: A young woman plagued with bad luck travels to Thailand to visit a friend. There, her friend suggests a visit to a sorcerer, which results in her adopting a child ghost/demon who begins to protect her, but matters soon go awry.

Title: 801. Norman Loves Rose
description: A teenage boy falls hopelessly in love with his new sister-in-law. When she gets pregnant, someone raises the question that he might be the father--a notion he does nothing to discourage.

Title: 802. Karding
description: THIS IS AN ACTION-DRAMA FILM.

Title: 803. Brothers
description: News photographer Adam and journalist Kevin, two fictional estranged brothers who witnessed the real life 1975 killing of the Balibo Five in Timor, reunite after five years only for their PTSD to resurface and tear them apart.

Title: 804. Taaqat
description: Devi and Shakti Singh gets married but Ambica loves him secretly. Devi kill husband's step-brother and his friends as they tries to molest her and runs away and comes under protection of Dacoit Bhawani Singh where she gives birth to a boy.

Title: 806. Gharib fi Baiti
description: A single mother and a football player from the countryside find themselves fighting over the same apartment after its deceitful owner gave them duplicate contracts.

Title: 807. Brusten himmel
description: Erika is 13 years and lives with her parents and her grandmother in the far north of Sweden. It's in the 40's. The family is depressed and disappointed in life. Erika dreams of a separate being in another world.

Title: 808. Het beest
description: When he finds out that his company has expropriated his own mother, a successful young manager gets deeply upset. Money and power now have a different meaning. He needs to struggle against his own self and stake everything in order to reorganize true values in his life. His career is at stake. When his mother dies in the pension she's been put, his point of limit is reached. He feels responsible and takes revenge through terrorist actions. The beast explodes.

Title: 810. Curse of the Red Butterfly
description: The hunt for an ancient jewel in Istanbul.

Title: 812. Kazhu Maram
description: The story of a mother-son relationship. Raghavan, a school dropout engages in petty thefts. He is branded as a thief after being caught stealing and runs away from his village not knowing what to do...

Title: 813. Entre paréntesis
description: Two men have problems committing to relationships with their partners. They live it up, in town to remain independent, but their heartstrings are pulled when their women do exactly the same.

Title: 814. Trandafirul galben
description: Continuing the adventure from Road of Bones, the heroes of the film, led by Margelatu, after a series of events and overcoming some obstacles, bring to the country the weapons bought from Vienna.

Title: 815. Y a-t-il un Français dans la salle?
description: Horace Tumelat, a powerful politician was raised by his uncle Eusèbe. He has to find a letter written by his uncle who committed suicide.

Title: 816. El chanfle II
description: El Chanfle is seen performing this activity. As the eighth symposium of the club was approaching Sr. Matute has the honor of telling the news to all his staff.

Title: 817. Requiem
description: A woman finds out that one of her doctor husband's patients used to be the cellmate of her first husband, who died in prison years before.

Title: 819. Tir groupé
description: One evening, after dinner in a restaurant with his girlfriend Carine, who works in a luxurious parfumerie, Antoine who sales clothes aux puces à Clignancourt, walks her back to the train station. But, while travelling back to Enghein to her parents' house, she's attacked by three thugs in front of others passengers who are unable to protect her... One of the thug hits her violently and kills her... While the police search for the theee men, Antoine starts a revengeful journey all the while remembering his relationship with Carine.

Title: 820. Umbartha
description: After the passing of her husband, Mrs. Mahajan takes care of four institutions, and lives a comfortable lifestyle with her two sons - Dr. Mohan and his wife, Maya; and Advocate Subhash Mahajan, his wife, Savitri, and their daughter, Rani. Savitri is unhappy as she wants a career for herself. She finally gets a chance to prove her skills in social services when she gets a job offer as Superintendent of a Women's Reformatory Home in distant Sangamwadi. Although Rani and Subhash as well as the rest of the family oppose her going, she has made up her mind. She arrives there and soon gets actively involved in the day to day activities of the institute, which is home to many women with a criminal background; who have been abused and beaten by their husbands; those who have been sexually assaulted; and even some with mental problems. After several months of her active involvement, Savitri is faced with a crisis when the Managing Committee, led by Chairperson Sheela Samson blames her for the death of two inmates, who set themselves on fire; her inability to get along with local businessmen; her rude comments to the local M.L.A., Bane; her interference in the personal lives of inmates. And to make matters the State Government appoints a one-man Commission to look into the problems of this institution. Savitri now has a choice - to resign and return home - to a family of virtual strangers; or stay and face the onslaught of charges that may be brought out against her.

Title: 821. Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman
description: A martial arts master stages an assassination attempt against a prince, in order to go undercover in the 'Ghostly Village', a hidden place where wanted criminals go to hide. Once there, he begins to investigate their secretive leader.

Title: 823. El cepo
description: A maniac murders beautiful women, then stores their bodies in a freezer.

Title: 824. Girl from India
description: A father (Ralph Maraj) who has settled in Trinidad has just come back from India with Rina (Sanam Suri), a bride for his son Sham (Bhalinder). The only problem is, Sham is so hopelessly shy and/or repressed by his cultural background that he cannot bring himself to engage in any intimacy, of any kind, with his new bride. Being Indian, he is well aware that his bride may desire to have a relationship with a man and so he gives her free rein to enter into any sort of liaison she wants. Rina does fall in love with an artist (Kabir Bedi) and has a baby by him, but her father-in-law is outraged at her behavior and kills the artist. Rina herself is later put on trial for the death of another man, even though she is innocent and has actually framed by her father-in-law. As the story moves along, there are musical numbers worked into the scenes (one of the friends is a performer) that are lively and entertaining in themselves.

Title: 825. El caballito volador
description: In this storybook tale from Mexico, a young boy and his flying pony are on an adventurous quest to find a way to rescue his family's farm.

Title: 826. Spaghetti House
description: Three black militants kidnap the waiters in an Italian restaurant in London. Soon the victims befriend their kidnappers.

Title: 827. Deadly Game
description: A hunting party arrives at a lodge in the Tatra mountains in Slovakia, where one woman in the party had "accidentally" shot and killed her first husband some time ago.

Title: 828. 41 el hombre perfecto
description: Mamerto Borrego is a 41-year-old orphan who after three marriages inherits a great fortune. Even so, he cannot find happiness until he meets his psychiatrist.

Title: 829. Fifty-fifty
description: A gang of youths turns to grown ups, but they realize it's not all that trouble-less they had thought, so they decide to bring back their band and go on a tour before the adult life takes control.

Title: 830. The Brazilwood Man
description: Fantasy comedy about Brazilian writer Oswald de Andrade, one of the most important icons of Modernism in Brazil. In the film, Oswald is played by two actors: Ítala Nandi, as his feminine anima, and Flávio Galvão, as the masculine half.

Title: 831. ¡Que vienen los socialistas!
description: Spain, year 1982. In a small Spanish city produces the special shock the announcement of the next elections. And, above all, the political forces of center and right are moved by the claim that the Socialists are going to win by thrashing. Then the hunt for possible alliances begins. Each of the delegates of the center parties wants to win the favors of the delegate of the PSOE in the area.

Title: 833. Castle of De Sade
description: Three university students and their professor are researching parapsychology and occult science in an old castle and invokes the spirit of Marquis de Sade.

Title: 834. Alsino and the Condor
description: Alsino, a boy of 10 or 12, lives with his grandmother in a remote area of Nicaragua. He's engulfed in the war between rebels and government troops when a US advisor orders the army to open a staging area by the boy's hamlet. Alsino tries to be a child, climbing trees with a girl, looking through his grandfather's trunk of mementos and trying to fly; he goes to town to sell a saddle, has his first drink and is taken to a brothel. But the war surrounds him. The US advisor takes Alsino on a chopper flight, but he's unimpressed. The soldiers' cruelties awake rebel sympathies in Alsino, and after an army assault backfires, the lad is fully baptized into the conflict.

Title: 835. Raging Master's Tiger Crane
description: Li-Siu, a young Shaolin monk, avenges the death of an abbot by challenging the murderous Silver Fox while uncovering a sinister mastermind plot to invade China.

Title: 836. Jeevan Dhaara
description: An overwhelmed Mr. Shrivastav is unable to shoulder the responsibility of raising and looking her his wife, two daughters, and one son, he leaves home, and decides to be a celibate hermit. The son, Ashok, is an unemployed alcoholic, unable to find employment, and prefers gambling, and living on the earnings of his sister, Sangeeta. His family had hoped that getting him married, would make him responsible, in vain though, and to make matters worse he gets intimate with his wife frequently, which results in her giving birth to children, who all add to the financial burden of this household. Geeta is the second daughter, who is widowed, and is now living with her family. Sangeeta is the only one employed, and carrying the responsibility of this family on her shoulders. When her father returns home, she hopes to resign from her job, and marry her sweetheart, Prem, but alas, the father again leaves them, and Sangeeta returns to her employment. Complications arise when Geeta falls in love with Prem, and Sangeeta decides to get them married. The family rent out a room to a struggling and unemployed young man by the name of Anand Bhatnagar, who is unable to pay any rent, and is secretly in love with Sangeeta. When Anand rescues Kalpana from killing herself, Sangeeta arranges their marriage. Unable to offend Sangeeta, Anand agrees to marry Kalpana. Things turn around for Sangeeta when Ashok finally quits drinking and gets a job as a waiter, and her boss, Kanwal, proposes marriage to her. Sangeeta is all set to resign from her job, get married, and live a comfortable life, not knowing that fate has something else in store for her.

Title: 837. Esabat Hamadah wa Tutoo
description: The boss at a large travel company fires Hamada, who worked there as a manager, after stealing all of his innovative ideas. Deprived of their usual income, Hamada and his wife Tutu decide to fix their financial problems in an unusual way, namely by robbing small banks, small shops and even pharmacies.

Title: 838. Kaseki no kouya
description: A detective is attacked by a trio of men at his apartment. When he wakes up, the corpse of a foreigner shot with his pistol lies in front of him. With the help of his journalist friend, he reveals a conspiracy related to lost WW2 gold.

Title: 840. Giggi il bullo
description: Giggi is a city boy convinced that "in life you must always hit first". And, good or bad, he gains a certain popularity between beatings, dates and blows taken.

Title: 841. Boulevard des assassins
description: At his publisher's request, an uninspired writer, Daniel Salmon, heads to the French Riviera to recharge his batteries, and begin a new novel. While staying at a friend's property, a phone call plunges him into a murky real estate scandal.

Title: 842. The Personals
description: A touching yet humorous tale of a divorced man searching for love in the personals column and finding out about life in the process.

Title: 843. To Trap a Kidnapper
description: Hideyuki Mitamura, a student at a private school near Osaka, is kidnapped on his way home from school.

Title: 844. Ferocious Female Freedom Fighters, Part 2
description: This is the story of women. Women shattered by violence. Women left alone, the sole survivors of slaughtered families. Women sold into a vicious and brutal international crime syndicate. Women subjected to poverty, horror and brutal sex.

Title: 845. Hocu zivjeti
description: Deals with the father-son conflict in a farming family. The two never see eye to eye especially over the way the farm is run. The boy opts for a different way of life and also falls in love with a dumb girl to the horror of his family.

Title: 846. 13. jul
description: This is a movie about the start of uprising People Montenegro in World War II. After the capitulation of the Yugoslav Royal Army in April 1941, the Italians managed to infiltrate their puppet regime in Montenegro. However, people dissatisfied with the new authorities, on July 13, 1941 decided that the Communists led start to fight for freedom.

Title: 847. Aspern
description: A publisher seeks information on a writer who died long ago.

Title: 849. A Japanese Village
description: In the very heart of the Japanese mountains, Ogawa discovers a village still dealing with the trauma of global warfare and struggling for survival as their children flee for the cities.

Title: 850. Jouer sa vie
description: The international chess match is cast as a classic Western shoot-out. Three chess greats dominate the film: Russia's Anatoly Karpov; Viktor Korchnoi, a Russian defector; and American Bobby Fischer.

Title: 851. Will the High Salaried Workers Raise Their Hands!
description: The cynical boss of a big insurance agency invites his top-salary employees to spend a weekend in his country house. Also invited: a modest clerk who discovers the hidden reason for the party--and decides to take advantage of it.

Title: 852. Strike the Interests
description: People run to bankers with the dream of living in prosperity. Kamil also sells his retirement bonus, three months' salary and his house, giving all his money to the bankers. One day they receive the news that the bankers have escaped.

Title: 853. Beach House
description: Teenagers from Brooklyn go the beach for a vacation and run into trouble with rich snobs from Philadelphia.

Title: 854. Bezubaan
description: A young woman must try to keep a one-night stand that she had in college a secret from her husband who happens to be one of his best friends, and thowart a persistant blackmailer intent on collecting money from her to keep quite about it.

Title: 855. Ninja Kids
description: 3 boys are told they are Japanese orphans and raised by I-Ho Ninja Society. They learn they are Chinese and the Society tries to kill them.

Title: 857. Vakil Babu
description: Shekhar Kumar lives a solitary life and earns his living sculpting, as he is blind. One day he meets with lovely Kalpana Choudhry, both fall in love with each other, and eventually get married. After their marriage they decide to go on a cruise for their honeymoon. It is here that Shekhar finds out that Kalpana left him and went out one night with another male named Prem Oberoi, with whom she in love with at one time. When he confronts her and asks her if she married him out of pity, she denies it. The next day, Kalpana does not find Shekhar in his room and goes looking for him, and asks the ships' captain and crew for help. They do find Shekhar as well as Prem's dead body. Shekhar confesses that he had killed Prem, so he is held in custody and turned over to the police when the ship lands. In Court, Shekhar enters a guilty plea and asks for quick justice. Advocate Mathur is appointed as his defense lawyer, but gets no co-operation from Shekhar, as such Justice Rajvansh has now to decide whether Shekhar should hang or be sentenced in prison for life.

Title: 858. Un echipaj pentru Singapore
description: An episode of courage and devotion on a Romanian commercial vessel during the 1980s. The master of the ship sacrifices himself during rough seas to avoid an eventual disaster.

Title: 859. Noa at 17
description: Set in Israel 1951, Noa is a member of a youth movement who fights for her individuality, her right to doubt and question all beliefs - all conformisms. An ideological battle takes place when the Kibbutz Movement must decided whether to follow Soviet Russia or join the Western world. The debate splits families and the kibbutz, and Noa's group of friends. She is not a person of compromise and fights her way independently through a world of shattered values.

Title: 860. Big Shots
description: Four men whose combined intellect does not reach into the triple digits decide to steal a safe full of foreign currency - not from a local bank, but from the police station. Based on a real-life incident, the screenplay for this slapstick comedy-drama was co-written by a policeman, also a play-writer, Haim Merin, lending a certain voice of authority to the setting, and the director, Jacob Goldwasser. The comedic high point of the film is when the four thieves bumble and bang their way through the police station, while the policeman on guard duty slumbers on in blissful ignorance. The thieves may be running on more muscle than Gery matter, more chemicals than Dow, and more luck than forethought, but they pull off the supposedly impossible robbery. From that point onward though, luck dwindles away as their greed surpasses their grasp of how to follow up on their success.

Title: 861. False Eyelash
description: The love between a prostitute/vaudeville performer and her younger rent-boy/actor lover is tested when another old lady lures the boy with more wealth to offer.

Title: 862. El hijo del cura
description: In a village in the Spanish Levante, lives Justo, the priest. He is loved by all the neighbors for his way of helping others.

Title: 863. Conquest
description: When the patriarch of Japan's most powerful yakuza family is shot, his wife is left to pick up the pieces and carry on the legacy.

Title: 864. Burdel
description: Innocent man forced to hide from the police, ends up taking refuge in a brothel.

Title: 865. La seta ibérica
description: A businessman thinks he hit the jackpot when the nubile and sexy hitchhiker he picked up not only stays at his place for a while, but also invites her equally sexually liberated friends along. But turns out he got a lot more than he can possibly handle.

Title: 866. Payanangal Mudivathillai
description: Radha falls in love with Ravi, an aspiring singer, and helps him rise to fame. But she struggles to declare her love for him, while Ravi tries to hide the grim fate that he awaits from Radha and her father.

Title: 867. Dil... Akhir Dil Hai
description: In Mumbai, Kusam and Vimal's arranged marriage fails as he only sees her as a mother. After their fathers' death, Vimal loves another woman. Kusam attempts divorce despite India's strict laws.

Title: 868. Eccezzziunale... veramente
description: The misadventures of three soccer fans, all played by Abatantuono.

Title: 869. Private Life
description: A man gets fired from his comfortable government job. He reacts as if it's the end of the world; slowly he finds things to live for. Private Life was nominated for the Academy Award in the Foreign Language Feature category.

Title: 870. Main Intequam Loonga
description: Kumar, from a wealthy family, loves Mala and boxing. He learns Ganga is his real mother and his father, a boxer, was killed for not throwing a fight. Kumar seeks revenge, risking his own life in the process.

Title: 871. Bariq Aynayk
description: Salwa, a flight attendant, marries the pilot Walid despite knowing he has a child from a previous marriage. After she becomes pregnant, Walid departs on a flight, but the plane crashes and he is presumed dead. Years later, Salwa marries Hazem until the past resurfaces in an unexpected way.

Title: 872. The Fake Ghost Catchers
description: A love-sick man commits suicide then comes back as a powerful and vengeful ghost. It's up to a trio of wacky young men to stop him.

Title: 873. Angkor: Cambodia Express
description: An American journalist returns to Cambodia to bring out the girlfriend he was forced to leave behind when the murderous Khmer Rouge took over the country.

Title: 874. Teri Kasam
description: A spoiled rich girl falls for a poor aspiring musician. But after they marry, their egos and respective stubbornness cause them to drift apart.

Title: 876. Bhujang
description: Zana is asked to take spiritual help after she and her her daughter spot Bhujung a spiritual snake in fields.She also has to deal with her husbands overeating disease and unwed pregnancy of her daughter.Where spiritual help cheats on her

Title: 877. Ti spacco il muso, bimba!
description: A clumsy investigator works in society with his dog and investigates a series of murders.

Title: 878. The Last Train: Kyong-wei Son
description: The last train allowed to pass the newly formed DMZ allowing those that wanted to return to their homes to do so, but wouldn't let those wanting to return north to ever return. The Last Train is a saga about people touched by civil war.

Title: 879. Insaan
description: Shankar lives with his stepmother and stepbrothers who ill-treat him. When they fall on tough times, they want to take away all that Shankar has earned.

Title: 880. The Contest
description: An outdoors orientation contest turns into a journey to the participants' self and conscience.

Title: 881. Heads I Win, Tails You Lose
description: Two dramedy stories: 1. A priest loses his memory after being hit on the head and forgets about his vow of celibacy. 2. A construction worker begins to suspect that his teenage son is gay.

Title: 882. Bambang
description: A SUB-DISTRICT OF TONDO IS THE SETTING OF THIS ACTION-DRAMA FILM ON STREET GANG WARS.

Title: 883. In Our Water
description: A New Jersey family discovers their drinking water is contaminated with deadly poisons from a nearby landfill.

Title: 886. My Juan en Only
description: This romantic comedy is Dolphy's first team-up with Charo Santos.

Title: 887. Boxoffice
description: After performing at a Hollywood nightclub, Eve Chandler falls asleep and has a nightmare that her baby is killed .

Title: 888. Cercasi Gesù
description: Giovanni is a young man who has been used by a catholic publishing house to advertise, with his face, a publication by installments concerning Jesus life. Francesca is a mysterious girl he met on the street and who's being sought by the police. They leave together, but will their troubles catch up with them ?

Title: 889. Aventuras de um Paraíba
description: Young guy from the poor Northeast region of Brazil comes to Rio de Janeiro to try his luck. Naturally, he is faced with many adversities along the way.

Title: 890. The Secret of the Mummy
description: Laughed at when he announces the discovery of the elixir of life, scientist Professor Expedito Vitus devotes himself to the reconstitution of a map that has been divided into eight parts. The owners of these parts are being mysteriously murdered. Thanks to this map, he ends up making the most important archaeological discovery of the century: the tomb of Runamb, the Mummy, in the sands of Egypt. Back in Brasil, the professor brings the Mummy back to life, who was actually a dangerous psychopathic murderer obsessed with the image of Nadja, the dancer who had rejected him.

Title: 892. Angela merge mai departe
description: One woman taxi driver in Bucharest is hoping for a conventional relationship.

Title: 893. Gopichand Jasoos
description: A middle-aged private detective faces challenges when he accepts an assignment to trace stolen diamonds.

Title: 894. Five Fingers of Steel
description: An evil martial arts school attempts to take over a small village, killing the benevolent head of a security service in the process. Revenge is of course the order of the day.

Title: 895. Bello mio bellezza mia
description: Gennarino Laganà is a poor Sicilian man who stays busy with humble jobs to support his family while his parents push him to seek his fortune in the North.

Title: 896. As Gatas, Mulheres de Aluguel
description: In the first of two episodes, the story follows a bureaucrat's marriage with his beautiful wife. In the second, a country boy ends up becoming a gigolo in the big city.

Title: 897. Krypskyttere
description: A conflict between the Norwegian military and the civilian population during the cold war. A disagreement arises about the right to a military shooting field.

Title: 898. Engler i sneen
description: The ordinary Espen in his twenties loses his drivers license and job due to drunk driving. He discovers one day that he has competition when it comes to charming his girlfriend Unni.

Title: 899. T-Bird at ako
description: A sexy dancer who has been accused of homicide is defended by a female lawyer who tries to keep their relationship professional as the latter struggles with the confusion of thoughts and emotions brought about by her budding affections for the dancer.

Title: 900. Fifteen Boys Adrift
description: A troop of children from eight to thirteen, abandoned on an island, struggling for life in the midst of passion fueled by the differences of nationalities. A story in the style of Robinson Crusoe revisited by Jules Verne.

Title: 901. Raj Mahal
description: Rajmahal's king murdered, usurper Durjan Singh rules cruelly. King's sons separated as kids, later reunite unknowingly in competition. After realizing brotherhood, they plan to overthrow tyrannical Durjan Singh and restore rightful heir.

Title: 902. Las computadoras
description: Upon returning from abroad, a young man goes to a trendy girls club without knowing that the owner is his own mother.

Title: 903. Alaloum
description: Set against the backdrop of early-1980s Greece and peppered with unblushing advertisements, Harry Klynn's enthusiastic triptych unfolds, capturing the aspirations of an entire nation, its desires and fears before a brave new world.

Title: 904. Desire
description: An American executive on a work stint in the Philippines meets a young Filipina who may be his daughter by a former lover.

Title: 905. Godfather from Canton
description: A coolie is offered a job as a policeman, after saving a government official, and through deception and corruption, he rises through the ranks of the police, all the while becoming a feared and respected gangster.

Title: 906. Dolina Issy
description: The film evokes a childhood in rural Lithuania between the wars. A country boy, Tomaszek, lives on a rich estate, situated on the Polish border. He realizes that the Issa Valley he lives in is to be torn apart by internal political conflicts and unrests among the mixed population of Poles, Lithuanians, Jews and Russians. He, however, is captivated by a paradise surrounding him, the forest, and his fantasies.

Title: 907. New York Chinatown
description: Bloody gang fight story in New York China Town.

Title: 908. The Adventures of Zipi and Zape
description: At the beginning of the new school year, Zipi and Zape meet a new student, Oliverio, who is bullied by other classmates. They decide to protect introverted Oliverio, gaining his friendship, then they discover that he is from a rich family. Zipi and Zape help Oliverio enjoy life by going to a party with girls from another school. A group of clumsy gangsters tries to kidnap Oliverio, with the complicity of his butler Bautista. After several failed attempts, they finally kidnap him disguised as Chinese. Zipi and Zape then ask their girl friends, who work at the radio station, for help. The children make a public appeal that thrills the town, urging many to help, from characters that had appeared (such as the teacher and classmates), to others introduced in a surreal way (such as parodies of the Hulk and Charlie's Angels). The gangsters are apprehended in a crowded scene. Bautista, wracked with guilt, rescues Oliverio and convinces him to say that it was all Bautista's joke. Zipi and Zape end with a song.

Title: 909. Traveling Hopefully
description: A documentary about Roger Baldwin, the founder of the ACLU.

Title: 910. Savamala
description: The events that preceded the WWII and subsequent fall of bourgeoisie in Yugoslavia are shown through the bloody strikes and awakening of civic consciousness in Belgrade's poor neighborhood of Savamala.

Title: 911. Ninja: The Violent Sorceror
description: A murderer, with the help of Chinese vampires, does battle with the ghost of a dead gambling lord's wife and the gambling lord's living brother.

Title: 912. Ich bin dein Killer
description: A corrupt lawyer hires a killer to murder his client's divorced ex-wife.

Title: 914. The Spirit of the Sword
description: There are five main clans ruling the martiall world, each representing one of the five elements - fire, metal, water, wood and earth. Each year they hold a martial arts competition to decide which one of the five clans will rule the world. The story is centered around one of these tournaments, as a catastrophe arises when an evil samurai killer shows up 49 days before the start and tries to assassinate the current leader who happens to be from the water clan.

Title: 915. Quella peste di Pierina
description: Pierina is a thirteen-year-old who tells dirty jokes, especially at school and at home.

Title: 916. San Miguel el alto
description: A cockfighter and his driver are attacked by unknown assailants but emerge unharmed. Jesus reports the incident to his friend Mario, the municipal president of San Miguel el Alto.

Title: 918. Isaac... Dugo ni Abraham
description: DESTINED BY FATE TO REDRESS WRONG DOINGS AND PROTECT THE OPPRESSED, ISAAC IS RAISED BY A GURU-HERMIT WHO ALSO TRAINS HIM IN THE MARTIAL ARTS.

Title: 919. Gaano kadalas ang minsan?
description: Two women are in love with the same man: one is his wife, the other is his mistress, and between them is the man whose love and time they share. But even the most discreet of affairs can be laid open, and even the most submissive of wives can lost her patience. Vilma Santos, Hilda Koronel and Dindo Fernando lend their thespic talents to this moving tale of love, betrayal, and retribution.

Title: 921. Samraat
description: Captain Chawla has been employed for years with a cargo shipping company run by Ranbir. While celebrating the new year, Chawla hears gunshots and goes below to investigate. He finds out that one of his officers, Gomes, has shot and killed a drunken sailor. Before he could do anything to address this situation, there is an explosion abroad the ship, "Samraat", which subsequently sinks. Ranbir finds out that Chawla was misusing his captaincy and smuggling gold bars, and files a police complaint, Chawla is arrested and imprisoned. His daughter, Suman, returns from England and decides to find out what really happened as her dad claims that he is innocent. In order to carry out this investigation, she hires two crazy divers, Ram and Raju alias Raj, who decide to undertake this mission. Then Ram finds out that the ship contains gold bars which are virtually their's for the taking. He informs Raj, only to find out that Raj is only interested in handing over the gold to the Government, as he has fallen in love with Suman, and wants to assist her in proving her dad's innocence. The question remains will both friends be able to reconcile their differences, and is Chawla really telling the truth?

Title: 922. Adalat O Ekti Meye
description: Urmila is gang-raped by men from rich and influential families. She decides to get justice despite facing ostracism and humiliation from the society and the culprits' families.

Title: 923. Beyond Forty
description: Un groupe d'amis se retrouve après trente ans de séparation. À travers eux des problèmes fondamentaux à tous les hommes et à toutes les femmes parvenus à l'âge de la maturité ressurgissent. À partir de situations où famille, amour, fidélité, homosexualité, réussite professionnelle sont en cause, c'est la question plus vaste du rapport que les adultes entretiennent avec leur enfance qui est soulevée.

Title: 924. Madrasile Mon
description: Based on the Karikkan villa murder case of 1980. Originally related to a geriatric couple murder that happened in Thiruvalla, in which a four member team of young men were involved.

Title: 927. Cinderella
description: When the Prince and Cenerentola meet, it is love at first sight.

Title: 928. Konoko no nanatsu no oiwai ni
description: The palmist "blue-moth (Seiga)" is rumored to manipulate the Japanese political and business from behind. Journalist Omoda had inquired into the "blue-moth" but is killed. Sudo who is Omoda's juniors of the newspaper he used to be in took over Omoda's work.

Title: 929. Talk to Me
description: Richard, a successful New York accountant whose idea of exercise is to go to the movies and to whom Central Park is the great outdoors, hasn't exactly taken life by the horns. He has a chronic stuttering problem and has caused great exhaustion and strife for him. After trying a number of different therapies (unsuccessfully) to alleviate his condition, he decides to enter the real-life Hollins Institute, an actual treatment center devoted to the research and cure for stuttering. With the help of a kind, devoted doctor and an attractive, younger fellow-patient, Richard goes on a journey to overcome his condition and his inner-demons.

Title: 930. Older Master Cute Part II
description: With the help of Mr. Chu's time machine, Master Q, Big Potato and Mr. Chun travel back to the fourteenth century to meet Xi Menqing and Wu Dalang, characters from Water Margin, one of the four great classical novels of Chinese literature

Title: 931. Nobody's Wife
description: After finding out her husband cheated on her, Leonor decides to leave him to find her true identity.

Title: 932. Das Tripas Coração
description: Financial and administrative problems in a religious school for girls force the Government to interfere. While waiting in the conference hall to communicate the fact to the school administrators, the intervenor falls asleep and a crazy dream begins, involving teachers, students and strange characters.

Title: 933. Curse of Evil
description: 13 family members are murdered and then dumped in a well. 30 years later their descendants are cursed.

Title: 934. Direktan prenos
description: Two young men and a girl, going through all the dilemmas of their generation, live together and try to build different world, to find their place in society. The manner of their life, understanding of truth and justice, love and passion, gets each of them in conflict with environment, with people who want to change their relationship and fit them into accepted moral norms. They are giving in slowly, and their whole world changes. Some of them will fit the dull everyday's life, and some will find strength to resist.

Title: 936. Spittin' Image
description: A twin falls off a wagon and meets a mountain man who teaches her to spit tobacco for a living.

Title: 937. A Ghost Love Story of Japan
description: A daughter of Hatamoto (high-ranked soldier) Otsuyu (Akiko Kana) and a Ronin living in Choya (cheap apartment) Shinzaburo Hagihara (Yoichi Hayashi) fell in love with each other. They could not see each other for a while, but Otsuyu visited Shinzaburo's place late at night, led by a servant Oyone (Shoko Yagi). Tomorrow night and next night as well.

Title: 938. The God Makers
description: Two former Mormons seek to file a class-action lawsuit against The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, detailing for skeptical attorneys the history, doctrines and secret rituals of the Mormon religion.

Title: 939. Grog
description: Two convicts escape from prison and evade the law by taking hostage the middle-class family of a doctor. One of the jailbirds calls the local television station, requesting that they broadcast his demand for a plane so they can escape the country. The television director and his crew show up to film the hostage crisis, and then things get progressively more bizarre and satirical. Not content with the living drama, he directs everyone's actions to make the event more newsworthy.

Title: 940. Zhenatyy kholostyak
description: Bus depot CEO tries to prevent turnovers by promoting family values. Meanwhile, a bus driver suddenly fell in love with young lonely mother. Fighting fot her love, he makes her parents believe he is her long lost husband.

Title: 941. Dio li fa poi li accoppia
942. La máxima felicidad
description: Two men and a woman are about to experience living as a threesome, this process brings out of them their fears, some moral barriers must be dismantled before the complex process of understanding and accepting each other can succeed.

Title: 943. Haathkadi
description: Harimohan lives with his wife, Shanta, and a his young son named, Sunil. He works for a lecherous male, who would like to have sex with Shanta. One night while Harimohan is sent on an errand, the boss molests Shanta, but due to bad weather, Harimohan returns early just in time to stop his boss from raping Shanta. A fight ensues between his boss and himself, and a result his boss is killed. Harimohan makes a run for it in his boss' car, which meets with an accident, and he is believed to have been killed. This news devastates Shanta. Years go by, Shanta has got used to living a widow's life. Sunil has grown up to be a police inspector. Sunil works undercover, and meets with Baldev Mittal, the only son of Gopaldas Mittal. Baldev is rich and arrogant, and as this results in a clash between these two young men. When a young woman, Sunita, is killed, Sunil finds evidence linking her death with Baldev, and he arrests him, and has him tried for murder. What Sunil does not know that Gopaldas Mittal has an alias - that of Saakhia - a notorious and influential gangster who will never let anyone stand in his way. Sunil also does not know that Saakhia is none other than his own biological father, who is still alive, and has taken to a life of crime.

Title: 944. Hei yu da tao wang
description: A group of men escape a prison camp during the Japanese invasion of China. It's up to them to fight their captors and take back their homeland.

Title: 945. Déjà le sang de mai ensemençait novembre
946. She Kept Asking for the Moon
description: Johanka (Milka Zimkova) had a fling with a well digger (Peter Vons) she had not met before and who, she was most likely certain, would never be around again. Just before his departure, they have sex and she eventually becomes single mother of a baby girl. 18 years later (her now 18-year-old daughter Paulina, Veronika Jenikova) commutes by bus to work in the nearby city, which gives the village gossips the occasional opportunity to remind her of her unknown father. A resultant conflict with her mother makes Paulina take up residence in the city. Johanka, prodded by her also-single friend Jozefka (Marie Logojdova) who maintains that a woman without a man is nothing, begins to woo the new teacher Jarek (Jiri Klepl) only to discover later that he is married. Paulina, in the meantime, loses her virginity to the soldier Jirka (Ivan Klecka) who promptly makes himself scarce. Johanka fails to consider that she actually has a better life than some of her married neighbors, begins to see abortion or marriage as Paulina's only options, and places personals on her behalf. Although Stefan (Lubomír Paulovic), one of the men who respond, turns out to be less than ideal, Paulina falls for him. As Stefan's car breaks down on the way to the elaborate wedding party and the cake adorned with a doll he is bringing begins to melt in the heat, Paulina, in her wedding dress and tipsy before the ceremony, suffers miscarriage, perhaps as a result of Johanka's earlier attempt to induce abortion that would look as if it occurred spontaneously. The car that carries Paulina to the hospital passes Stefan's car towed by a farm tractor, but none of the involved notice.

Title: 948. El cabezota
description: The establishment of obligatory school for children divides to a father and his little son.

Title: 949. Quell and Co.
description: Wicked land mogul threatens group of Texas homesteaders in post-Civil War western.

Title: 950. En busca del huevo perdido
description: Three sisters, who live on his farm impersonate three professional singers who were going to perform in the town; these were spies, so they are hired by the CIA to get hold of a gadget invented by a mad scientist.

Title: 951. Os Trapalhões na Serra Pelada
description: The friends Curió, Boroca (Dedé Santana), Mexelete and Bateia they venture in search of gold in the mine of Serra Pelada. The area is controlled by the foreigner Von Bermann, whose orders are executed by the bully Bira. Thirsty of being able to, the foreigner smuggles the gold and he wants to take possession of the lands of the Brazilian Ribamar, that refuses to do business before the son's arrival Chicão. With the help of the four dabblers, the boy struggles with the thieves and it helps the father in danger.

Title: 952. Shen tui mi zong shou
description: When the going gets tough, the tough start throwing! Members of the government are using their position to rob and steal, so it's up to a young Kung Fu expert (Jacky Lee) to stop them, using the secret techniques of the Shaolin. But when he runs into even tougher opponents, he's forced to learn more Shaolin training -- including the 5 Animals style -- so he can defeat the dreaded One Braid Killer, who's out to kill our hero and his allies.

Title: 953. I camionisti
description: Ofelia, the handsome operator of a service station, attracts the attentions of several admirers, including her former lover Rocky, a truck driver, and the noble Sir Archibald.

Title: 954. The Eyes of the Amaryllis
description: In 1880, a little girl is sent to Nantucket Island to live with her grandmother. She discovers, however, that her grandmother is an odd woman who has some strange habits, one of which is keeping a vigil for a lover of many years ago who went out to sea one day and never returned.

Title: 955. Relasyon
description: The story follows the trials of a woman as she risks to build a meaningful relationship with a married man despite the different hurdles that abound.

Title: 956. A House Divided: Denmark Vesey's Rebellion
description: Story of Denmark Vesey, who was raised as a slave but bought his freedom. He organized a plot to seize the city and free the black slaves, but this failed and he and others were hanged. Set in Charleston in 1822.

Title: 957. Five-Year Diary
description: The best work of American filmmaker Anne Charlotte Robertson published by LUX. Includes an interview with the filmmaker and Scott MacDonald, a new essay by Lisa Blackman and writings by Anne Charlotte.

Title: 959. Sarah and the Squirrel
description: The story is about a little girl during the beginning of the Second World War. It is also known as "Sarah" and "The Seventh Match".

Title: 960. Cicciabomba
description: An overweight high school student is relentlessly bullied due to weight. Out of the blue, she wins a trip to New York, where she sheds 80+ pounds and then returns home to take revenge on her tormentors.

Title: 961. Likainen puolitusina
description: A group of men arriving to their military refresher training are tasked with finding a lost football bomb meant for a film shoot.

Title: 962. La contrabandista
description: After losing her family to home invaders, a woman moves to the city and becomes entangled with both a drug kingpin and a taxi driver.

Title: 963. Corridas de alegría
description: Miguel, escaped from prison two months before serving his sentence, thinks about getting revenge and finding his girlfriend. He bundles Javier, a card guy with a convertible, on a trip through Andalusia in search of the missing girl.

Title: 964. Ayaash
description: While most of his countrymen are busy protesting the British rule, Thakur Jaswant Singh chooses to live a carefree life. He hires a personal photographer who soon becomes the reason for his downfall.

Title: 965. Aamne Samne
description: Johny lives a dual life--as a popular starlet and an international criminal wanted by the police for a number of criminal activities. He meets his lookalike Gopi, who comes from the village in search of a job; Johny offers Gopi the job, a salary, and a house to live in. This job involves playing the role of Johny so that the real Johny can outsmart the police and commit his criminal activities with ease. He teaches Gopi his mannerism and etiquette with things going as planned. But Gopi eventually gets trapped--both by the police and the underworld criminal gang.

Title: 966. Man Into Woman: The Transsexual Experience
description: Documentary explores the real-life experiences of transgender people, mainly trans women, living in Australia in the early 1980s. Uses interviews and personal stories, interspersed with archival footage, to show what life was like for them socially, medically, and legally at that time.

Title: 967. Ne mogu skazat 'proshchay'
description: When tragedy befalls the athletic Sergei, Lida softens his toughened shell with steadfast love.

Title: 968. Quartetto Basileus
description: The internationally renowned string quartet had been performing together for most of their adult lives when their lead violinist suddenly died, leaving the remaining three confused about their lives and careers.

Title: 969. Tennessee Stallion
description: A low-class horse-trainer breaks into the world of aristocratic thoroughbred racing.

Title: 970. Ehrengard
description: Wolfgang Cazotte, a famous, refined and charming court painter of the early 19th century, conceives an idea: to seduce Ehrengard, a young and fiery virgin, without touching her, but only causing the blush of complicity to rise to her cheeks. In the end, after the painter's cunning is turned back upon him, everything will go for the best.

Title: 971. Filhos e Amantes
description: During a weekend in a country house, young people eager for strong emotions end up switching partners and experimenting drugs.

Title: 972. Djecak je isao za suncem
description: Story of a 12 year old orphaned boy who takes to wandering about the countryside after the death of his drunkard father.

Title: 973. Tomruk
description: Two woodsmen ,who are best friends, decided to transport timbers through the river. A woman accompany them at the crossroads.

Title: 974. Assarab
description: A man discovers money in a flour bag. It is the beginning of a story between pats and future, between silence and cry, and that ends like a disillusion.

Title: 975. The French
description: For the very first time, a documentary team is allowed to shoot sequences in the backstage of the French Open of tennis of Roland-Garros.

Title: 976. The Parallel Corpse
description: A mortuary worker uncovers the identity of a serial killer after finding one of his victims in the mortuary's coffins. However, instead of turning him over to the police, he blackmails him. Complications ensue.

Title: 977. Star
description: Dev Kumar Verma comes from a middle-class family and must find employment to support his dad and mom. Dev, however, has set his mind upon becoming a music sensation like Elvis Presley. He loses his job because of this, and refuses to work until and unless he gets a job to his liking, much to the dismay of his parents and his brother, Shiv Kumar. Dev does get employment at Charlie's Disco, where he meets with Maya and falls in love with her. When Charlie's Disco's competitor, Rana, finds out about Dev, he wants to hire Dev, but Dev decides to continue to work with Charlie's Disco, as a result Dev and Charlie get a beating by Rana's men, and Dev is unable to sing. After recuperating, Dev is devastated to find out that Maya and Shiv Kumar are in love with each other. What impact will this have on Dev and his brother on one hand, and what of his career in music?

Title: 978. Shao Lin san shi liu ban deng
description: 37 children of Shao Lin Temple are descendants of the glorious Ming Clan and are under threat from a notorious and ambitious Ching Clan leader. They must learn the ways of the Buddha and battle the Ching Clan to a standstill.

Title: 979. Story of Three Loves
description: THE BITTER-SWEET EXPERIENCES OF THREE YOUNG WOMEN IN LOVE ARE DRAMATIZED IN THIS ROMANTIC DRAMA.

Title: 980. Vado a vivere da solo
description: A young man named Giacomino leaves his parents to live on his own, but he quickly finds that it is more difficult than he thought.

Title: 981. Dobrodruzství Robinsona Crusoe, námorníka z Yorku
description: A full-length picture based on the famous novel by Daniel Defoe. The picture, unlike the other film adaptations of the story, focuses much more on Crusoe's life before and after his stay on the island. Following the principle of setting the novel right, it describes Crusoe's experiences with delicate irony and understanding.

Title: 982. Impossible Woman
description: A female Ninja starts a war against the drug cartel she was forced to work for.

Title: 983. Cyclops
description: Melkior Tresic is one of many intellectuals in 1941 Zagreb who is helplessly waiting for the encroaching war.

Title: 984. The Train Has Stopped
description: You have to break the written rules to get things going. Later, the authorities will sort it out: whether you're a criminal or a hero.

Title: 985. Pater Gomenios
description: When a legendary lady-killer's sexual prowess suddenly vanishes after marriage, he flees to a monastery as a stylite monk to escape family pressure—only to find women flocking to his pillar for a divine "blessing."

Title: 986. Space Runaway Ideon: A Contact
description: The Solo ship and its crew continue to battle against the Buff Clan leading to the final battle that will determine the fate of all life in the universe

Title: 987. Raiders of Galaxy
description: A group of young space cadets use a technologically advanced mecha to combat an evil extraterrestrial race that is trying to take over the galaxy.

Title: 988. Oh! Takarazuka
description: A gym teacher wants to work at a girls' high school for the worst reasons. He gets the job of his dreams on an island with an overabundance of beautiful young women. Will he be able to win their hearts despite his problem?

Title: 989. Poetry in Motion
description: More than 20 contemporary North American poets recite, sing, and perform their work. Several also comment. Early in the film, Charles Bukowski talks about the energy of poets and of a poem. These poets are energetic performers, and their poems are meant to be heard. These poets are the children of Walt Whitman and of Charles Olson, incantatory and oratorical, radical, sometimes incorporating contemporary political imagery. Black Mountain poets, the Beats, minimalists like John Cage, the wordless Four Horsemen, Tom Waits, and others capture aspects of poets as troubadours.

Title: 991. Lonely Fifteen
description: Five girls rejected by their family and not fit to the educational system will join the Hong Kong underworld, copying the TV and the American life style models; their desires for freedom clash with their society's customs and traditions.

Title: 992. Kyôdan
description: A run-in with the police once again puts three former reformatory inmates on the wrong side of the law. Their situation becomes increasingly desperate as events spin out of control, culminating in an audacious hijack at sea.

Title: 993. Chunyong-ran
description: A misunderstanding between some orphans and a noble family leads to tragic consequences when some local gangsters get involved.

Title: 994. Kiddonappu burûsu
description: A man and a little girl meet in a bicycle parking in Tokyo. The little girl says she wants to watch the sea, and their travel begins.

Title: 996. Cha-Cha-Cha
description: Teenagers try to get to know the opposite sex during Sunday afternoon dance classes in Budapest in 1962.

Title: 997. Olangal
description: Ravi and Radha are happily married until Father John shows up with Raju, Ravi's illegitimate son. To avoid any complications in his marriage life, Ravi introduces Raju as his dead friend's son.

Title: 998. Black Hair, Velvet Soul
description: Drunk husband who is addicted to gambling get into trouble with local Yakuza. Unable to pay his debt, he deed his wife Izumi' in order to stay out of trouble with the thugs.

Title: 999. Sandstorm
description: An eighth daughter. In this Saharan village, what a disgrace for Amara to have no heir. Blinded by anger, he repudiates his wife. But Amara cannot bear that others know a happiness that has been denied to him.
